interpretation:
**영어 중심 번역(EN→14개 언어, 14개 언어→EN) 39개 모델 비교이며, 판정자는 gpt-6-astra와 claude-fable-5.1입니다.** 모델당 3,080문장(일반 문장 2,800 + 금융 문서 280)을 5점 척도로 채점했습니다. 같은 번역을 이전 판정자(gpt-5.6-sol + fable-5)로도 채점한 결과(`영어 중심 번역 비교 · 판정 sol+fable-5`)가 따로 있습니다. 한국어 쌍(KO↔X)은 이 런에 포함되지 않습니다.

**판정자를 바꿔도 결론은 같습니다.** 두 판정 체계의 모델별 종합 점수 상관은 0.9998이고, 순위 변화는 평균 0.26칸입니다. 상위 5개 모델은 동일합니다: gpt-6.1-sol 4.96, gpt-6-astra 4.96, claude-opus-5.5 4.95, gpt-5.5 4.93, claude-fable-5.1 4.93. 이 사이의 0.01~0.03점 차이는 순위로 단정하기 어렵습니다.

**가성비는 저가 모델이 압도합니다.**
- gpt-6-luna 4.92 — 문장당 약 $0.00011
- gemma-4-31b 4.85 · claude-haiku-5.5 4.84 — 문장당 약 $0.00007 · $0.00015
- gpt-6.1-sol 4.96 — 문장당 약 $0.0015로 최상위 품질 중 가장 저렴

**방향 차이는 모델 크기에 따라 다릅니다.** 작은 모델일수록 X→EN이 EN→X보다 훨씬 쉽습니다(exaone-3.5-32b: EN→X 3.61, X→EN 4.33). 상위 모델은 두 방향이 거의 같고, gpt-6.1-sol·gpt-6-astra·amazon-translate는 EN→X가 오히려 근소하게 높습니다.

**어려운 언어는 태국어·튀르키예어·아랍어·베트남어·힌디어(EN→X)입니다.** 모델 평균 기준 EN→태국어 4.45가 가장 낮고, X→EN 중에는 독일어(4.88)·포르투갈어(4.87)·프랑스어(4.87)가 가장 높습니다.

**금융 문서에서는 모델 격차가 더 벌어집니다.** amazon-translate는 일반 문장 4.63이지만 금융 문서는 3.35이고, exaone-3.5-32b는 3.44, llama-3.1-8b는 3.57입니다. 금융 문서가 중요하면 일반 문장 점수만 보고 고르지 마세요.

**한계**
- gpt-6-astra와 claude-fable-5.1은 판정자이면서 번역 후보이기도 합니다. 자기 번역은 상대 판정자 한 명의 점수만 사용했고(gpt-6-astra→fable-5.1, claude-fable-5.1→astra), 두 모델은 판정자가 1명이라 품질 통과율 같은 두 판정자 기반 지표가 없습니다.
- GPT 계열 판정자와 Claude 계열 판정자의 같은 계열 편향은 완전히 제거되지 않았습니다.
- claude-sonnet-4.5(14건)와 claude-fable-5.1(4건)은 번역이 반환되지 않은 실패가 있고, 이는 해당 모델의 실패로 집계했습니다.
- 금융 문서 참조 번역은 LLM이 만든 것이라 평가자에게 제공하지 않았습니다.
- vLLM 모델의 비용은 GPU 시간당 단가÷실측 처리량 환산이라 API 모델과 직접 비교는 참고용입니다. 응답 시간은 제공자마다 동시 처리 수가 달라 방향성만 참고하세요.

GPT-6.1 Terra · 영어↔14개 언어 · 동일3080개 입력 · reasoning low · temperature 생략 · 출력 상한4096. 두 평가자 조합은 동일한 번역 응답을 각각 채점합니다. 기존39개 모델의 점수·비용·샘플은 그대로 보존했습니다. 측정 시점은 다릅니다.

GPT-6.1 Terra의 한국어·영어 번역 수집 시간이 일부 겹쳤습니다. 각 작업의 동시성은 8이지만 같은 모델 서비스에 동시 요청이 발생했습니다. 금융 QA·모델 소개·롯데타워 생성도 한국어 번역 수집 중에 수행했습니다. 지연·처리량은 관측값이며 단독 부하 실험과 직접 비교에 한계가 있습니다.

metric_policy.quality_eligibility: Successful translation with a valid averaged judgment and complete raw axes/overall for two distinct actual judges, including fallback identities. Explicit judges_used is authoritative and malformed values are unavailable. Only when judges_used is absent, recover identities from exactly two raw-score prefix groups, both complete and valid; extra groups or incomplete evidence are unavailable. Never infer raw scores from averages.

judge_weakest_axis_mean.method: mean of each segment's minimum raw axis score across both actual judges
judge_weakest_axis_mean.interpretation: Custom conservative quality diagnostic, not a verified error rate.

high_risk.rule: either actual judge; a judge risk flag, not a verified factual error

rates.coverage_scope: Retained successful translations, not the full configured dataset. Translation failures are excluded and reported separately.

baseline.population: common valid averaged-judgment segment IDs; raw-score eligibility not required
baseline.win_tie_loss: candidate overall greater than / exactly equal to / less than baseline overall
baseline.mean_delta: segment-weighted mean of candidate overall minus baseline overall; positive favors candidate

bootstrap.method: paired source-cluster percentile bootstrap on the segment-weighted mean delta
bootstrap.cluster_ids: FLORES sentence ID across languages/directions; synthetic source-language parent ID across targets; unrecognized segment IDs remain independent
bootstrap.ci_unavailable: fewer than two paired source documents

estimated_translation_cost.scope: latest successful translation rows only; not total billed experiment spend
excluded: superseded retries and failed translation attempts
GPU setup/idle time outside each observed source-run batch
estimated_translation_cost.pricing_source: supplied model configuration; retain historical rates for reused models
estimated_translation_cost.multi_run_timing: Throughput is unavailable when a model retains rows from multiple source runs, including failed replacements: retained subsets do not prove full source-batch membership. All GPU-derived costs are then null; token/character-priced costs remain available.
estimated_translation_cost.request_deadline_timing: Mantle throughput is also unavailable when recorded invocations changed the client request deadline. Fully cached invocations made no requests and are ignored. Recorded deadline history is exposed in run_config; token-priced costs remain available.
estimated_translation_cost.cost_per_quality_pass_usd: whole-model cost_total_usd / quality_pass_segments; null if zero passes or any successful translation lacks a valid judgment or complete raw two-judge scores

provenance.precedence: included runs in argument order, then primary; last (model, id) row wins, including errors
provenance.judgment_join: A retained judgment must have the same source run as its retained translation. A cross-run judgment is not attached; the translation remains not_yet_judged.
provenance.reused: observations retained from included runs, rather than executed in the primary run
provenance.source_manifests: Recorded historical provenance; a manifest may describe only the last execution and need not list every model in its caches.
provenance.recorded_model_run_configs: per-model execution/pricing snapshots from a source's published report, if available
provenance.judge_cost_scope: retained judgments across all source runs, including reused judgments; not incremental primary-run spend
provenance.compatibility: conflicting available dataset/prompt/rubric hashes reject combination; missing hashes remain unverified

measurement_scheduling.note: GPT-6.1 Terra의 한국어·영어 번역 수집 시간이 일부 겹쳤습니다. 각 작업의 동시성은 8이지만 같은 모델 서비스에 동시 요청이 발생했습니다. 금융 QA·모델 소개·롯데타워 생성도 한국어 번역 수집 중에 수행했습니다. 지연·처리량은 관측값이며 단독 부하 실험과 직접 비교에 한계가 있습니다.

* Education and outreach programs for local communities

# تقرير الأرباح الفصلية - الربع الثالث 2023

## شركة الخليج للصناعات الكيميائية (ش.م.ع)

**التاريخ:** 15 أكتوبر 2023

### ملخص الأداء المالي

يسر شركة الخليج للصناعات الكيميائية أن تعلن عن نتائجها المالية للربع الثالث من عام 2023. حققت الشركة أداءً قوياً خلال هذه الفترة، مدفوعة بزيادة الطلب على منتجاتها الأساسية في أسواق الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا.

### الأداء المالي الفصلي

| الفترة | الإيرادات (مليون ريال) | الربح التشغيلي (مليون ريال) | صافي الربح (مليون ريال) |
|--------|------------------------|----------------------------|------------------------|
| الربع الأول 2023 | 847.5 | 156.3 | 112.8 |
| الربع الثاني 2023 | 923.2 | 178.9 | 134.5 |
| الربع الثالث 2023 | 1,045.7 | 215.4 | 167.2 |

### التحليل والتعليق

ارتفعت إيرادات الربع الثالث بنسبة 13.3% مقارنة بالربع الثاني، لتصل إلى 1,045.7 مليون ريال سعودي. ويعزى هذا النمو إلى:

- **زيادة حجم المبيعات:** ارتفع حجم المبيعات بنسبة 18% نتيجة توسع قاعدة العملاء في دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي
- **تحسن هوامش الربح:** بلغ هامش الربح التشغيلي 20.6% مقارنة بـ 19.4% في الربع السابق
- **كفاءة التشغيل:** انخفضت التكاليف التشغيلية بنسبة 7% بفضل برامج التحسين المستمر

### المركز المالي

بلغ إجمالي الأصول 4.8 مليار ريال سعودي في نهاية الربع الثالث، بينما وصل حقوق المساهمين إلى 2.3 مليار ريال. حافظت الشركة على نسبة سيولة قوية عند 1.8، مما يعكس قدرتها على الوفاء بالتزاماتها قصيرة الأجل.

### التوقعات المستقبلية

تتوقع الإدارة استمرار النمو في الربع الرابع من عام 2023، مع إيرادات متوقعة تتراوح بين 1,100 و 1,150 مليون ريال سعودي. كما تخطط الشركة لاستثمار 350 مليون ريال في توسعة المصنع الرئيسي بمدينة الجبيل الصناعية خلال عام 2024.

# Quarterly Earnings Report - Q3 2023

## Gulf Chemical Industries Company (PJSC)

**Date:** October 15, 2023

### Financial Performance Summary

Gulf Chemical Industries Company is pleased to announce its financial results for the third quarter of 2023. The Company achieved strong performance during this period, driven by increased demand for its core products in the Middle East and North Africa markets.

### Quarterly Financial Performance

| Period | Revenue (SAR million) | Operating Profit (SAR million) | Net Profit (SAR million) |
|--------|----------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------|
| Q1 2023 | 847.5 | 156.3 | 112.8 |
| Q2 2023 | 923.2 | 178.9 | 134.5 |
| Q3 2023 | 1,045.7 | 215.4 | 167.2 |

### Analysis and Commentary

Third quarter revenues increased by 13.3% compared to the second quarter, reaching SAR 1,045.7 million. This growth is attributed to:

- **Increased sales volume:** Sales volume rose by 18% as a result of customer base expansion in the Gulf Cooperation Council countries
- **Improved profit margins:** Operating profit margin reached 20.6% compared to 19.4% in the previous quarter
- **Operational efficiency:** Operating costs decreased by 7% thanks to continuous improvement programs

### Financial Position

Total assets reached SAR 4.8 billion at the end of the third quarter, while shareholders' equity reached SAR 2.3 billion. The Company maintained a strong liquidity ratio of 1.8, reflecting its ability to meet short-term obligations.

### Future Outlook

Management expects continued growth in the fourth quarter of 2023, with projected revenues ranging between SAR 1,100 and 1,150 million. The Company also plans to invest SAR 350 million in expanding the main plant in Jubail Industrial City during 2024.

# إفصاح تنظيمي: تغيير في حصص المساهمين الرئيسيين

**رقم الإفصاح:** 2024-156-TS  
**تاريخ الإفصاح:** 15 مارس 2024  
**الجهة المصدرة:** شركة الخليج المتحدة للاستثمارات المالية (ش.م.ع)

## تفاصيل الإفصاح

تعلن شركة الخليج المتحدة للاستثمارات المالية (ش.م.ع) المدرجة في سوق دبي المالي تحت الرمز (GUFI) عن تغيير جوهري في هيكل ملكية المساهمين الرئيسيين وفقاً لمتطلبات هيئة الأوراق المالية والسلع.

### تفاصيل المعاملة

بتاريخ 12 مارس 2024، قامت مجموعة الإمارات القابضة للاستثمار بشراء حصة إضافية في الشركة من مؤسسة الأفق للتنمية بقيمة إجمالية قدرها **285,750,000 درهم إماراتي** (مائتان وخمسة وثمانون مليوناً وسبعمائة وخمسون ألف درهم).

### تفاصيل الأسهم المنقولة

| البيان | العدد | النسبة المئوية | القيمة (درهم) |
|--------|-------|----------------|---------------|
| عدد الأسهم المنقولة | 47,625,000 | 8.5% | 285,750,000 |
| سعر السهم الواحد | - | - | 6.00 |
| إجمالي رأس المال | 560,000,000 | 100% | 3,360,000,000 |

### الوضع قبل وبعد المعاملة

**مجموعة الإمارات القابضة للاستثمار:**
- الحصة قبل المعاملة: 67,200,000 سهم (12.0%)
- الحصة بعد المعاملة: 114,825,000 سهم (20.5%)
- التغيير: زيادة بنسبة 8.5%

**مؤسسة الأفق للتنمية:**
- الحصة قبل المعاملة: 89,600,000 سهم (16.0%)
- الحصة بعد المعاملة: 41,975,000 سهم (7.5%)
- التغيير: انخفاض بنسبة 8.5%

### معلومات إضافية

تمت المعاملة خارج السوق المالي بموجب اتفاقية بيع وشراء موقعة بين الطرفين بتاريخ 8 مارس 2024. تم استيفاء جميع الموافقات التنظيمية المطلوبة من هيئة الأوراق المالية والسلع بتاريخ 11 مارس 2024.

لن يترتب على هذه المعاملة أي تغيير في مجلس إدارة الشركة أو في استراتيجيتها التشغيلية الحالية.

**جهة الاتصال:**  
قسم علاقات المستثمرين

الهاتف: 4-3337788-04-971+

# Regulatory Disclosure: Change in Major Shareholders' Stakes

**Disclosure Number:** 2024-156-TS  
**Disclosure Date:** 15 March 2024  
**Issuing Entity:** Gulf United Financial Investments Company (PJSC)

## Disclosure Details

Gulf United Financial Investments Company (PJSC), listed on the Dubai Financial Market under the symbol (GUFI), announces a material change in the ownership structure of major shareholders in accordance with the requirements of the Securities and Commodities Authority.

### Transaction Details

On 12 March 2024, Emirates Investment Holding Group purchased an additional stake in the Company from Al Ofok Development Corporation for a total value of **AED 285,750,000** (two hundred eighty-five million seven hundred fifty thousand dirhams).

### Details of Transferred Shares

| Item | Number | Percentage | Value (AED) |
|--------|-------|----------------|---------------|
| Number of Shares Transferred | 47,625,000 | 8.5% | 285,750,000 |
| Price per Share | - | - | 6.00 |
| Total Share Capital | 560,000,000 | 100% | 3,360,000,000 |

### Position Before and After the Transaction

**Emirates Investment Holding Group:**
- Stake Before Transaction: 67,200,000 shares (12.0%)
- Stake After Transaction: 114,825,000 shares (20.5%)
- Change: Increase of 8.5%

**Al Ofok Development Corporation:**
- Stake Before Transaction: 89,600,000 shares (16.0%)
- Stake After Transaction: 41,975,000 shares (7.5%)
- Change: Decrease of 8.5%

### Additional Information

The transaction was executed off-market pursuant to a sale and purchase agreement signed between the parties on 8 March 2024. All required regulatory approvals from the Securities and Commodities Authority were obtained on 11 March 2024.

This transaction will not result in any change to the Company's Board of Directors or its current operational strategy.

# Terms and Conditions of the Gold Credit Card - National Gulf Bank

## Article One: Definitions and General Provisions

1.1 "The Bank" in this document refers to National Gulf Bank PJSC, registered in the United Arab Emirates under commercial registration number 234567.

1.2 These terms and conditions shall be effective from 1 January 2024 and supersede all previous terms.

## Article Two: Fees and Commissions

2.1 **Annual Issuance Fee**: The primary card issuance fee is AED 850 annually, and the supplementary card is AED 425.

2.2 **Cash Withdrawal Fees**: 
- Within the United Arab Emirates: 3.5% of the withdrawn amount with a minimum of AED 50
- Outside the United Arab Emirates: 4.25% of the withdrawn amount with a minimum of AED 75

2.3 **Annual Interest Rate**: 
- Purchase transactions: 2.99% monthly (41.5% annually)
- Cash withdrawals: 3.25% monthly (45.9% annually)

## Article Three: Additional Fees Schedule

| Service Type | Fee in UAE Dirhams |
|------------|------------------------|
| Late payment fee | AED 230 |
| Over-limit fee | AED 150 |
| Returned cheque fee | AED 200 |
| Damaged card replacement fee | AED 100 |
| Paper statement fee | AED 25 monthly |
| Foreign currency transaction fee | 2.75% of transaction value |

## Article Four: Credit Limit and Payment

4.1 The credit limit is determined by the Bank based on the customer's creditworthiness, with a minimum of AED 15,000 and a maximum of AED 500,000.

4.2 The minimum monthly payment is 5% of the total outstanding balance or AED 200, whichever is greater.

4.3 Payment due date: on the twenty-fifth day of each calendar month.

## Article Five: Rewards Program

5.1 The cardholder earns one point for every AED 10 spent locally, and one and a half points for every AED 10 for international transactions.

5.2 Points validity: 36 months from the date of earning.

## Article Six: Service Termination

6.1 The Bank has the right to terminate the service with 30 days' prior notice in case of breach of terms.

6.2 Early closure fee during the first year: AED 500.

# وثيقة وصف صندوق الاستثمار المتوازن للنمو

## معلومات أساسية عن الصندوق

**اسم الصندوق:** صندوق الخليج المتوازن للنمو والدخل  
**مدير الصندوق:** شركة الأمانة للاستثمار المالي ش.م.ع  
**تاريخ التأسيس:** 15 مارس 2018  
**العملة الأساسية:** الدرهم الإماراتي (AED)  
**الحد الأدنى للاستثمار:** 50,000 درهم إماراتي  
**رقم الترخيص:** DFSA/2018/0342

## أهداف الصندوق الاستثماري

يهدف صندوق الخليج المتوازن إلى تحقيق نمو رأسمالي طويل الأجل مع توليد دخل منتظم من خلال الاستثمار في محفظة متنوعة من الأسهم والسندات في أسواق دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي. يستثمر الصندوق 60% من أصوله في الأسهم المدرجة في أسواق الإمارات والسعودية والكويت، و40% في السندات الحكومية والشركات ذات التصنيف الائتماني العالي.

## هيكل الرسوم والعوائد التاريخية

### جدول الرسوم والمصاريف

| نوع الرسم | النسبة/المبلغ |
|---------|---------------|
| رسوم الإدارة السنوية | 1.75% |
| رسوم الاشتراك | 2.50% |
| رسوم الاسترداد (أقل من سنة) | 1.00% |
| رسوم الاسترداد (أكثر من سنة) | 0.00% |
| رسوم الحفظ السنوية | 0.15% |
| إجمالي نسبة المصاريف | 2.10% |

### العوائد السنوية التاريخية

| السنة | العائد السنوي | المؤشر المرجعي |
|------|--------------|----------------|
| 2023 | +8.45% | +7.20% |
| 2022 | +12.30% | +10.85% |
| 2021 | +15.67% | +14.20% |
| 2020 | -3.25% | -4.10% |
| 2019 | +9.80% | +8.95% |

**صافي قيمة الأصول الحالية:** 485.5 مليون درهم إماراتي (كما في 31 ديسمبر 2023)  
**سعر الوحدة:** 14.23 درهم إماراتي

## إفصاح المخاطر

**تحذير هام:** الاستثمار في هذا الصندوق ينطوي على مخاطر مالية كبيرة. قد تنخفض قيمة استثماراتك وقد لا تسترد المبلغ الأصلي المستثمر. الأداء السابق لا يشكل ضماناً للعوائد المستقبلية. يتعرض الصندوق لمخاطر السوق، مخاطر أسعار الفائدة، مخاطر السيولة، والمخاطر الجيوسياسية في منطقة الخليج. يجب على المستثمرين قراءة نشرة الإصدار الكاملة قبل اتخاذ قرار الاستثمار. هذا الصندوق مناسب للمستثمرين ذوي القدرة المتوسطة إلى العالية على تحمل المخاطر وأفق استثماري لا يقل عن 5 سنوات.

### ملخص الأداء المالي

# Quartalsbericht Q3 2024 - TechnoVision AG

## Zusammenfassung der Geschäftsergebnisse

Die TechnoVision AG (Frankfurt: TCV) gibt die konsolidierten Finanzergebnisse für das dritte Quartal des Geschäftsjahres 2024 bekannt, das am 30. September 2024 endete. Das Unternehmen verzeichnete einen Gesamtumsatz von 487,3 Millionen Euro, was einem Anstieg von 12,4% gegenüber dem Vorjahresquartal entspricht.

## Finanzielle Leistungskennzahlen

| Quartal | Umsatz (Mio. €) | Betriebsgewinn (Mio. €) | Nettogewinn (Mio. €) |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------------|----------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 423,7 | 67,2 | 48,9 |
| Q2 2024 | 456,1 | 73,8 | 52,3 |
| Q3 2024 | 487,3 | 81,5 | 59,7 |

## Operative Entwicklung

Der Betriebsgewinn (EBIT) erreichte im dritten Quartal 81,5 Millionen Euro, was einer operativen Marge von 16,7% entspricht. Diese Verbesserung ist hauptsächlich auf die erfolgreiche Einführung unserer neuen CloudSecure-Plattform und die gestiegene Nachfrage im Bereich Cybersicherheitslösungen zurückzuführen.

Der Nettogewinn stieg auf 59,7 Millionen Euro, verglichen mit 52,3 Millionen Euro im Vorquartal. Das Ergebnis je Aktie (EPS) betrug 1,87 Euro, eine Steigerung von 14,1% gegenüber Q2 2024.

## Segmentanalyse

Das Segment Enterprise Solutions generierte Umsätze in Höhe von 298,4 Millionen Euro (61,2% des Gesamtumsatzes), während das Segment Cloud Services 188,9 Millionen Euro (38,8%) beisteuerte. Beide Segmente zeigten zweistellige Wachstumsraten im Jahresvergleich.

## Ausblick

Für das vierte Quartal 2024 prognostiziert der Vorstand einen Umsatz zwischen 495 und 515 Millionen Euro. Die operative Marge wird voraussichtlich bei 16,5% bis 17,5% liegen. Das Management bekräftigt die Jahresprognose eines Gesamtumsatzes von mindestens 1,9 Milliarden Euro für das Geschäftsjahr 2024.

**Veröffentlichungsdatum:** 25. Oktober 2024  
**Kontakt:** investor.relations@technovision-ag.de
samples.ref_text:
# Quarterly Report Q3 2024 - TechnoVision AG

## Summary of Business Results

TechnoVision AG (Frankfurt: TCV) announces the consolidated financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, which ended on 30 September 2024. The company recorded total revenue of €487.3 million, representing an increase of 12.4% compared to the prior-year quarter.

## Financial Performance Indicators

| Quarter | Revenue (€ million) | Operating Profit (€ million) | Net Profit (€ million) |
|---------|---------------------|------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 423.7 | 67.2 | 48.9 |
| Q2 2024 | 456.1 | 73.8 | 52.3 |
| Q3 2024 | 487.3 | 81.5 | 59.7 |

## Operating Performance

Operating profit (EBIT) reached €81.5 million in the third quarter, corresponding to an operating margin of 16.7%. This improvement is primarily attributable to the successful launch of our new CloudSecure platform and increased demand in the cybersecurity solutions area.

Net profit rose to €59.7 million, compared with €52.3 million in the prior quarter. Earnings per share (EPS) amounted to €1.87, an increase of 14.1% compared to Q2 2024.

## Segment Analysis

The Enterprise Solutions segment generated revenue of €298.4 million (61.2% of total revenue), while the Cloud Services segment contributed €188.9 million (38.8%). Both segments showed double-digit growth rates on a year-over-year basis.

## Outlook

For the fourth quarter of 2024, the Executive Board forecasts revenue between €495 and €515 million. The operating margin is expected to be in the range of 16.5% to 17.5%. Management reaffirms the full-year guidance of total revenue of at least €1.9 billion for fiscal year 2024.

**Publication date:** 25 October 2024  
**Contact:** investor.relations@technovision-ag.de

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Report - TechnoVision AG

## Summary of Business Results

TechnoVision AG (Frankfurt: TCV) announces its consolidated financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, which ended on September 30, 2024. The company recorded total revenue of €487.3 million, an increase of 12.4% compared with the prior-year quarter.

## Financial Performance Indicators

| Quarter | Revenue (€ million) | Operating profit (€ million) | Net profit (€ million) |
|---------|---------------------|------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 423.7 | 67.2 | 48.9 |
| Q2 2024 | 456.1 | 73.8 | 52.3 |
| Q3 2024 | 487.3 | 81.5 | 59.7 |

## Operating Performance

Operating profit (EBIT) reached €81.5 million in the third quarter, representing an operating margin of 16.7%. This improvement is mainly attributable to the successful launch of our new CloudSecure platform and increased demand for cybersecurity solutions.

Net profit rose to €59.7 million, compared with €52.3 million in the previous quarter. Earnings per share (EPS) amounted to €1.87, an increase of 14.1% compared with Q2 2024.

## Segment Analysis

The Enterprise Solutions segment generated revenue of €298.4 million (61.2% of total revenue), while the Cloud Services segment contributed €188.9 million (38.8%). Both segments recorded double-digit year-over-year growth rates.

## Outlook

For the fourth quarter of 2024, the Executive Board forecasts revenue of between €495 million and €515 million. The operating margin is expected to be between 16.5% and 17.5%. Management reiterates its full-year forecast of total revenue of at least €1.9 billion for fiscal year 2024.

**Publication date:** October 25, 2024  
**Contact:** investor.relations@technovision-ag.de

# Meldung nach § 40 Abs. 1 WpHG – Veränderung des Stimmrechtsanteils

**Veröffentlichungsdatum:** 15. März 2024

**Emittent:** TechnoVision AG, Frankfurt am Main  
**ISIN:** DE0007236000

## Angaben zum Mitteilungspflichtigen

**Name:** Bergmann Capital Management GmbH  
**Sitz:** München, Deutschland  
**Registernummer:** HRB 245789

## Mitteilung über Stimmrechtsänderung

Hiermit teilen wir gemäß § 40 Abs. 1 WpHG mit, dass unser Stimmrechtsanteil an der TechnoVision AG am 12. März 2024 die Schwelle von 5% überschritten hat und nunmehr 7,42% beträgt.

### Aufschlüsselung der Stimmrechte

| Kategorie | Anzahl Stimmrechte | Anteil in % |
|-----------|-------------------|-------------|
| Direkte Zurechnung (§ 33 WpHG) | 1.245.800 | 4,98% |
| Indirekte Zurechnung (§ 34 WpHG) | 610.500 | 2,44% |
| **Gesamt** | **1.856.300** | **7,42%** |

**Gesamtzahl der Stimmrechte des Emittenten:** 25.020.000

### Transaktionsdetails

Die Schwellenüberschreitung erfolgte durch den Erwerb von 425.000 Aktien der TechnoVision AG zu einem durchschnittlichen Kaufpreis von EUR 48,75 je Aktie. Das Gesamtvolumen der Transaktion beläuft sich auf EUR 20.718.750,00.

Die Aktien wurden über die Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im Zeitraum vom 8. März 2024 bis 12. März 2024 erworben.

### Kette der kontrollierten Unternehmen

Die Stimmrechte werden Bergmann Capital Management GmbH über folgende kontrollierte Unternehmen zugerechnet:
- Bergmann Investment Holdings SE (100%)
- Bergmann Equity Fund III (87,5%)

### Ziele der Beteiligung

Die Beteiligung dient ausschließlich Anlagezwecken. Ein Erwerb weiterer Stimmrechte innerhalb der nächsten zwölf Monate ist beabsichtigt. Eine Einflussnahme auf die Besetzung von Verwaltungs-, Leitungs- und Aufsichtsorganen wird nicht angestrebt.

**Datum der Schwellenberührung:** 12. März 2024  
**Datum der Meldung:** 14. März 2024

---

*Bergmann Capital Management GmbH*  
*Maximilianstraße 45, 80539 München*  
*Geschäftsführer: Dr. Klaus Bergmann, Andrea Müller-Schmidt*

# Allgemeine Geschäftsbedingungen für das Premium-Girokonto der Deutschen Finanzbank AG

**Gültig ab: 1. Januar 2024**

## § 1 Kontoführung und Gebühren

1.1 Die monatliche Grundgebühr für das Premium-Girokonto beträgt 12,90 EUR. Bei einem monatlichen Mindestgeldeingang von 3.000 EUR entfällt diese Gebühr.

1.2 Für Kunden unter 28 Jahren wird das Konto gebührenfrei geführt.

## § 2 Transaktionsgebühren

2.1 Inländische Überweisungen in EUR sind kostenfrei.

2.2 Für SEPA-Überweisungen in andere EU-Länder fallen keine Gebühren an.

2.3 Auslandsüberweisungen außerhalb der EU werden wie folgt berechnet:

| Überweisungsbetrag | Gebühr |
|-------------------|--------|
| bis 500 EUR | 8,50 EUR |
| 501 - 5.000 EUR | 15,00 EUR |
| über 5.000 EUR | 0,3% des Betrags, mind. 25,00 EUR |

## § 3 Kreditkarte und Bargeldverfügung

3.1 Die Deutsche Finanzbank AG stellt eine Visa Premium-Kreditkarte mit einer Jahresgebühr von 49,00 EUR aus.

# Produktbeschreibung: GlobalWachstum Aktienfonds Plus

**ISIN:** DE000A2B8K47  
**WKN:** A2B8K4  
**Fondsgesellschaft:** Deutsche Vermögensverwaltung AG, Frankfurt am Main  
**Auflagedatum:** 15. März 2018  
**Fondswährung:** EUR

## Anlageziel und Strategie

Der GlobalWachstum Aktienfonds Plus investiert mindestens 75% des Fondsvermögens in internationale Aktien von Unternehmen mit hohem Wachstumspotenzial. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Technologie-, Gesundheits- und Konsumgüterunternehmen in Nordamerika, Europa und Asien. Das Fondsmanagement verfolgt einen aktiven Investmentansatz mit einem Anlagehorizont von mindestens 5 Jahren.

**Fondsvolumen:** 487,3 Millionen EUR (Stand: 31. Dezember 2024)  
**Anzahl der Positionen:** 62 Einzeltitel

## Kostenstruktur

| Kostenart | Prozentsatz/Betrag |
|-----------|-------------------|
| Ausgabeaufschlag | 5,00% |
| Verwaltungsvergütung (p.a.) | 1,65% |
| Verwahrstellenvergütung (p.a.) | 0,08% |
| Gesamtkostenquote (TER) | 1,89% |
| Performance-Fee | 15% über 8% Rendite |
| Mindestanlage | 1.000 EUR |

| Jahr | Rendite | Vergleichsindex MSCI World |
|------|---------|---------------------------|
| 2024 | +12,4% | +11,2% |
| 2023 | +18,7% | +16,8% |
| 2022 | -14,2% | -12,9% |
| 2021 | +24,3% | +21,8% |
| 2020 | +8,9% | +6,4% |
| 2019 | +28,1% | +27,3% |

## Risikohinweise

**Risikoklasse:** 5 von 7 (erhöhtes Risiko)

Dieser Fonds ist mit erheblichen Risiken verbunden. Die Wertentwicklung in der Vergangenheit ist kein verlässlicher Indikator für zukünftige Ergebnisse. Der Anteilswert kann stark schwanken und es besteht das Risiko eines vollständigen Kapitalverlusts. Währungsrisiken, Marktvolatilität und Konzentrationsrisiken können die Performance negativ beeinflussen. Der Fonds eignet sich nur für erfahrene Anleger mit langfristigem Anlagehorizont und ausreichender Risikobereitschaft. Bitte lesen Sie den ausführlichen Verkaufsprospekt und die wesentlichen Anlegerinformationen vor einer Investitionsentscheidung sorgfältig durch.

**Depotbank:** Frankfurter Sparkasse  
**Fondsmanager:** Dr. Klaus Bergmann (seit 2018)  
**Geschäftsjahresende:** 31. Dezember

# Quartalsbericht Q3 2024 - TechnoVision AG

## Zusammenfassung der Geschäftsergebnisse

Die TechnoVision AG (Frankfurt: TCV) gibt die konsolidierten Finanzergebnisse für das dritte Quartal des Geschäftsjahres 2024 bekannt, das am 30. September 2024 endete. Das Unternehmen verzeichnete einen Gesamtumsatz von 487,3 Millionen Euro, was einem Anstieg von 12,4% gegenüber dem Vorjahresquartal entspricht.

| Quartal | Umsatz (Mio. €) | Betriebsgewinn (Mio. €) | Nettogewinn (Mio. €) |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------------|----------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 423,7 | 67,2 | 48,9 |

| Q3 2024 | 487,3 | 81,5 | 59,7 |

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

For Q4 2024, the company expects revenue in the range of $865-$885 million and diluted earnings per share between $2.45 and $2.60.

# تقرير الأرباح الفصلية للربع الثالث 2024
## شركة تك فيجن إندستريز

**تاريخ التقرير:** 28 أكتوبر 2024  
**الفترة المالية:** الربع الثالث 2024 (1 يوليو - 30 سبتمبر 2024)

### الملخص التنفيذي

أعلنت شركة تك فيجن إندستريز (NASDAQ: TVII) اليوم عن النتائج المالية للربع الثالث من السنة المالية 2024. وقد سجلت الشركة إجمالي إيرادات بلغ 847.3 مليون دولار، وهو ما يمثل زيادة بنسبة 12.4% مقارنة بالربع الثالث 2023. وبلغ الدخل التشغيلي 156.2 مليون دولار، بينما بلغ صافي الدخل 118.7 مليون دولار، أو 2.34 دولار للسهم المخفف.

وقالت جينيفر مارتينيز، الرئيس التنفيذي: "يسعدنا تحقيق ربع آخر من الأداء المالي القوي. يواصل قسم البنية التحتية السحابية لدينا قيادة النمو، حيث ارتفعت الإيرادات بنسبة 28% على أساس سنوي لتصل إلى 312 مليون دولار. وقد قابل هذا النمو جزئياً ضعف الطلب في قطاع الأجهزة التقليدية."

### ملخص الأداء المالي

| الربع | الإيرادات (مليون دولار) | الدخل التشغيلي (مليون دولار) | صافي الدخل (مليون دولار) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| الربع الأول 2024 | 789.4 | 142.8 | 108.3 |
| الربع الثاني 2024 | 821.6 | 149.5 | 113.9 |
| الربع الثالث 2024 | 847.3 | 156.2 | 118.7 |

### أداء القطاعات

**البنية التحتية السحابية:** إيرادات بلغت 312.0 مليون دولار، بزيادة 28% على أساس سنوي، مدفوعة بزيادة اعتماد الشركات لمنصة CloudSync وتوسيع الشراكات مع كبرى شركات الاتصالات.

**برمجيات المؤسسات:** إيرادات بلغت 298.5 مليون دولار، بزيادة 8% على أساس سنوي، مدعومة بمعدلات تجديد قوية بلغت 94% واكتساب عملاء جدد في قطاع الخدمات المالية.

**حلول الأجهزة:** إيرادات بلغت 236.8 مليون دولار، بانخفاض 3% على أساس سنوي، مما يعكس التحول المستمر في السوق نحو الحلول السحابية.

### أبرز بنود الميزانية العمومية

في 30 سبتمبر 2024، حافظت تك فيجن على ميزانية عمومية قوية تتضمن:
- النقد والنقد المعادل: 1.24 مليار دولار
- إجمالي الديون: 450 مليون دولار
- حقوق المساهمين: 2.87 مليار دولار

### التوقعات المستقبلية

بالنسبة للربع الرابع 2024، تتوقع الشركة إيرادات تتراوح بين 865-885 مليون دولار وربحية للسهم المخفف تتراوح بين 2.45 و2.60 دولار.

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

For Q4 2024, the company expects revenue in the range of $865-$885 million and diluted earnings per share between $2.45 and $2.60.

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

For Q4 2024, the company expects revenue in the range of $865-$885 million and diluted earnings per share between $2.45 and $2.60.

**Date du rapport :** 28 octobre 2024  
**Période fiscale :** troisième trimestre 2024 (1er juillet - 30 septembre 2024)

### Résumé exécutif

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ : TVII) a annoncé aujourd'hui ses résultats financiers pour le troisième trimestre de l'exercice 2024. La société a enregistré un chiffre d'affaires total de 847,3 millions de dollars, soit une hausse de 12,4 % par rapport au troisième trimestre 2023. Le résultat d'exploitation a atteint 156,2 millions de dollars, tandis que le résultat net s'est établi à 118,7 millions de dollars, soit 2,34 $ par action diluée.

« Nous sommes heureux d'avoir réalisé un nouveau trimestre marqué par de solides performances financières », a déclaré Jennifer Martinez, directrice générale. « Notre division d'infrastructure cloud continue de soutenir la croissance, avec un chiffre d'affaires en hausse de 28 % sur un an, à 312 millions de dollars. Cette croissance a été partiellement compensée par une demande plus faible dans notre segment historique du matériel. »

### Synthèse des résultats financiers

| Trimestre | Chiffre d'affaires (en millions de dollars) | Résultat d'exploitation (en millions de dollars) | Résultat net (en millions de dollars) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| T1 2024 | 789,4 $ | 142,8 $ | 108,3 $ |
| T2 2024 | 821,6 $ | 149,5 $ | 113,9 $ |
| T3 2024 | 847,3 $ | 156,2 $ | 118,7 $ |

### Performance par segment

**Infrastructure cloud :** chiffre d'affaires de 312,0 millions de dollars, en hausse de 28 % sur un an, porté par l'adoption accrue de notre plateforme CloudSync par les entreprises et l'élargissement de nos partenariats avec de grands opérateurs de télécommunications.

**Logiciels d'entreprise :** chiffre d'affaires de 298,5 millions de dollars, en hausse de 8 % sur un an, soutenu par un solide taux de renouvellement de 94 % et l'acquisition de nouveaux clients dans le secteur des services financiers.

**Solutions matérielles :** chiffre d'affaires de 236,8 millions de dollars, en baisse de 3 % sur un an, reflétant la transition continue du marché vers des solutions basées sur le cloud.

### Faits marquants du bilan

Au 30 septembre 2024, TechVision affichait un bilan solide, avec :
- Trésorerie et équivalents de trésorerie : 1,24 milliard de dollars
- Dette totale : 450 millions de dollars
- Capitaux propres des actionnaires : 2,87 milliards de dollars

### Perspectives

Pour le quatrième trimestre 2024, la société prévoit un chiffre d'affaires compris entre 865 et 885 millions de dollars et un bénéfice par action diluée compris entre 2,45 $ et 2,60 $.

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

For Q4 2024, the company expects revenue in the range of $865-$885 million and diluted earnings per share between $2.45 and $2.60.

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

For Q4 2024, the company expects revenue in the range of $865-$885 million and diluted earnings per share between $2.45 and $2.60.

## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Tanggal Laporan:** 28 Oktober 2024  
**Periode Fiskal:** Kuartal Ketiga 2024 (1 Juli - 30 September 2024)

### Ringkasan Eksekutif

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) hari ini mengumumkan hasil keuangan untuk kuartal ketiga tahun fiskal 2024. Perusahaan membukukan total pendapatan sebesar $847,3 juta, yang mencerminkan peningkatan 12,4% dibandingkan Q3 2023. Laba usaha mencapai $156,2 juta, sementara laba bersih tercatat sebesar $118,7 juta, atau $2,34 per saham terdilusi.

"Kami senang dapat membukukan ևս satu kuartal dengan kinerja keuangan yang kuat," kata Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Divisi infrastruktur cloud kami terus mendorong pertumbuhan, dengan pendapatan meningkat 28% secara tahunan menjadi $312 juta. Pertumbuhan ini sebagian diimbangi oleh permintaan yang lebih lemah pada segmen perangkat keras lama kami."

### Ringkasan Kinerja Keuangan

| Kuartal | Pendapatan ($ juta) | Laba Usaha ($ juta) | Laba Bersih ($ juta) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789,4 | $142,8 | $108,3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821,6 | $149,5 | $113,9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847,3 | $156,2 | $118,7 |

### Kinerja Segmen

**Infrastruktur Cloud:** Pendapatan sebesar $312,0 juta, naik 28% secara tahunan, didorong oleh peningkatan adopsi platform CloudSync kami oleh perusahaan serta perluasan kemitraan dengan penyedia telekomunikasi utama.

**Perangkat Lunak Perusahaan:** Pendapatan sebesar $298,5 juta, naik 8% secara tahunan, didukung oleh tingkat perpanjangan kontrak yang kuat sebesar 94% serta perolehan pelanggan baru di sektor jasa keuangan.

**Solusi Perangkat Keras:** Pendapatan sebesar $236,8 juta, turun 3% secara tahunan, mencerminkan transisi pasar yang berkelanjutan menuju solusi berbasis cloud.

### Sorotan Neraca

Per 30 September 2024, TechVision mempertahankan neraca yang kuat dengan:
- Kas dan setara kas: $1,24 miliar
- Total utang: $450 juta
- Ekuitas pemegang saham: $2,87 miliar

### Prospek

Untuk Q4 2024, perusahaan memperkirakan pendapatan dalam kisaran $865-$885 juta dan laba per saham terdilusi antara $2,45 dan $2,60.

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

テックビジョン・インダストリーズ Inc.(NASDAQ: TVII)は本日、2024年度第3四半期の財務結果を発表しました。当社は総収益$847.3百万を報告し、2023年第3四半期と比較して12.4%の増加となりました。営業利益は$156.2百万に達し、純利益は$118.7百万、希薄化後1株当たり$2.34となりました。

「当社は再び堅調な財務実績を達成できたことを嬉しく思います」と、最高経営責任者のジェニファー・マルティネスは述べました。「当社のクラウドインフラストラクチャ部門は引き続き成長を牽引しており、収益は前年同期比28%増の$312百万となりました。この成長は、レガシーハードウェアセグメントにおける需要の軟化により一部相殺されました。」

**ハードウェアソリューション:** 収益$236.8百万、前年同期比3%減。クラウドベースソリューションへの市場移行が継続していることを反映しています。

### 貸借対照表ハイライト

2024年9月30日現在、テックビジョンは以下の強固な貸借対照表を維持しています:
- 現金及び現金同等物: $1.24十億
- 総負債: $450百万
- 株主資本: $2.87十億

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

For Q4 2024, the company expects revenue in the range of $865-$885 million and diluted earnings per share between $2.45 and $2.60.

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

For Q4 2024, the company expects revenue in the range of $865-$885 million and diluted earnings per share between $2.45 and $2.60.

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

For Q4 2024, the company expects revenue in the range of $865-$885 million and diluted earnings per share between $2.45 and $2.60.

# Q3 2024 Quarterly Earnings Report
## TechVision Industries Inc.

**Report Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Fiscal Period:** Third Quarter 2024 (July 1 - September 30, 2024)

### Executive Summary

TechVision Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: TVII) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024. The company reported total revenue of $847.3 million, representing a 12.4% increase compared to Q3 2023. Operating income reached $156.2 million, while net income stood at $118.7 million, or $2.34 per diluted share.

"We are pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial performance," said Jennifer Martinez, Chief Executive Officer. "Our cloud infrastructure division continues to drive growth, with revenue increasing 28% year-over-year to $312 million. This growth was partially offset by softer demand in our legacy hardware segment."

### Financial Performance Summary

| Quarter | Revenue ($ millions) | Operating Income ($ millions) | Net Income ($ millions) |
|---------|---------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | $789.4 | $142.8 | $108.3 |
| Q2 2024 | $821.6 | $149.5 | $113.9 |
| Q3 2024 | $847.3 | $156.2 | $118.7 |

### Segment Performance

**Cloud Infrastructure:** Revenue of $312.0 million, up 28% YoY, driven by increased enterprise adoption of our CloudSync platform and expanded partnerships with major telecommunications providers.

**Enterprise Software:** Revenue of $298.5 million, up 8% YoY, supported by strong renewal rates of 94% and new customer acquisitions in the financial services sector.

**Hardware Solutions:** Revenue of $236.8 million, down 3% YoY, reflecting ongoing market transition to cloud-based solutions.

### Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2024, TechVision maintained a strong balance sheet with:
- Cash and cash equivalents: $1.24 billion
- Total debt: $450 million
- Shareholders' equity: $2.87 billion

### Outlook

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |
| **Total Potential Value** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### Key Terms and Conditions

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

2. **Revenue Sharing:** Following the minimum guarantee period (24 months), the parties shall share net revenues on a 65/35 basis (Company/DataStream).

3. **Performance Milestones:** DataStream must deliver the core technology platform by September 30, 2024, with full integration support through December 31, 2024.

4. **Termination Provisions:** Either party may terminate with 180 days written notice if specified performance benchmarks are not achieved.

#### Impact Assessment

This Agreement is expected to contribute approximately $125 million to $180 million in additional revenue over the contract period, representing 18-24% of the Company's projected total revenue for fiscal years 2024-2029.

The initial payment of $45,000,000 represents approximately 8.2% of the Company's total assets as of December 31, 2023 ($548,000,000).

## Material Business Agreement Notification

**Filing Date:** March 15, 2024  
**Report Type:** Material Contract Disclosure  
**Filing Entity:** TechVenture Global Inc.  
**Stock Code:** TVGI-5820

---

### DISCLOSURE OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |
| **Total Potential Value** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### Key Terms and Conditions

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

2. **Revenue Sharing:** Following the minimum guarantee period (24 months), the parties shall share net revenues on a 65/35 basis (Company/DataStream).

3. **Performance Milestones:** DataStream must deliver the core technology platform by September 30, 2024, with full integration support through December 31, 2024.

4. **Termination Provisions:** Either party may terminate with 180 days written notice if specified performance benchmarks are not achieved.

#### Impact Assessment

This Agreement is expected to contribute approximately $125 million to $180 million in additional revenue over the contract period, representing 18-24% of the Company's projected total revenue for fiscal years 2024-2029.

The initial payment of $45,000,000 represents approximately 8.2% of the Company's total assets as of December 31, 2023 ($548,000,000).

**Board Approval Date:** March 11, 2024  
**Authorized Signatory:** Jennifer K. Morrison, Chief Executive Officer

---

*This disclosure is filed pursuant to applicable securities regulations.*

---

### DISCLOSURE OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |
| **Total Potential Value** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### Key Terms and Conditions

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

2. **Revenue Sharing:** Following the minimum guarantee period (24 months), the parties shall share net revenues on a 65/35 basis (Company/DataStream).

4. **Termination Provisions:** Either party may terminate with 180 days written notice if specified performance benchmarks are not achieved.

La Compañía ha celebrado un Acuerdo de Asociación Tecnológica Estratégica y Licenciamiento (el "Acuerdo") por cinco años con DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") para el desarrollo y comercialización de soluciones avanzadas de infraestructura de inteligencia artificial.

| Componente | Importe (USD) | Calendario de Pagos |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|

Se espera que este Acuerdo contribuya aproximadamente entre $125 millones y $180 millones en ingresos adicionales durante el período del contrato, representando el 18-24% de los ingresos totales proyectados de la Compañía para los ejercicios fiscales 2024-2029.

---

### DISCLOSURE OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

La Société a conclu un accord de partenariat technologique stratégique et de licence d'une durée de cinq ans (l'« Accord ») avec DataStream Solutions Ltd. (« DataStream ») pour le développement et la commercialisation de solutions d'infrastructure d'intelligence artificielle avancées.

| Composante | Montant (USD) | Calendrier de paiement |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|

### रणनीतिक साझेदारी समझौते का प्रकटीकरण

टेकवेंचर ग्लोबल इंक. ("कंपनी") एतद्द्वारा डेटास्ट्रीम सॉल्यूशंस लिमिटेड, एक डेलावेयर निगम, के साथ 12 मार्च, 2024 को संपन्न एक महत्वपूर्ण व्यावसायिक समझौते के निष्पादन का प्रकटीकरण करती है।

#### लेनदेन का सारांश

कंपनी ने उन्नत आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस अवसंरचना समाधानों के विकास और व्यावसायीकरण के लिए डेटास्ट्रीम सॉल्यूशंस लिमिटेड ("डेटास्ट्रीम") के साथ पांच वर्षीय रणनीतिक प्रौद्योगिकी साझेदारी और लाइसेंसिंग समझौता ("समझौता") किया है।

#### वित्तीय शर्तें

| घटक | राशि (USD) | भुगतान अनुसूची |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|

| विकास माइलस्टोन भुगतान | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| वार्षिक रॉयल्टी (न्यूनतम गारंटी) | $8,750,000 | त्रैमासिक किस्तें |
| प्रदर्शन बोनस (सशर्त) | $15,000,000 तक | राजस्व लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति पर |
| **कुल संभावित मूल्य** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### प्रमुख नियम और शर्तें

1. **बौद्धिक संपदा अधिकार:** कंपनी को मुख्य भूमि चीन को छोड़कर, एशिया-प्रशांत क्षेत्र में डेटास्ट्रीम के स्वामित्व वाले AI अनुकूलन एल्गोरिदम के लिए विशेष लाइसेंसिंग अधिकार प्राप्त होंगे।

2. **राजस्व साझाकरण:** न्यूनतम गारंटी अवधि (24 महीने) के बाद, पक्षकार 65/35 आधार (कंपनी/डेटास्ट्रीम) पर शुद्ध राजस्व साझा करेंगे।

3. **प्रदर्शन माइलस्टोन:** डेटास्ट्रीम को 30 सितंबर, 2024 तक मुख्य प्रौद्योगिकी प्लेटफॉर्म वितरित करना होगा, जिसमें 31 दिसंबर, 2024 तक पूर्ण एकीकरण सहायता शामिल है।

4. **समाप्ति प्रावधान:** यदि निर्दिष्ट प्रदर्शन मानदंड प्राप्त नहीं होते हैं तो कोई भी पक्ष 180 दिनों की लिखित सूचना के साथ समाप्त कर सकता है।

#### प्रभाव मूल्यांकन

इस समझौते से अनुबंध अवधि में लगभग $125 मिलियन से $180 मिलियन का अतिरिक्त राजस्व योगदान की अपेक्षा है, जो वित्तीय वर्ष 2024-2029 के लिए कंपनी के अनुमानित कुल राजस्व का 18-24% प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

$45,000,000 का प्रारंभिक भुगतान 31 दिसंबर, 2023 ($548,000,000) तक कंपनी की कुल संपत्ति का लगभग 8.2% प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

**बोर्ड अनुमोदन तिथि:** 11 मार्च, 2024  
**अधिकृत हस्ताक्षरकर्ता:** जेनिफर के. मॉरिसन, मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी

## Material Business Agreement Notification

**Filing Date:** March 15, 2024  
**Report Type:** Material Contract Disclosure  
**Filing Entity:** TechVenture Global Inc.  
**Stock Code:** TVGI-5820

---

### DISCLOSURE OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |
| **Total Potential Value** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### Key Terms and Conditions

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

2. **Revenue Sharing:** Following the minimum guarantee period (24 months), the parties shall share net revenues on a 65/35 basis (Company/DataStream).

3. **Performance Milestones:** DataStream must deliver the core technology platform by September 30, 2024, with full integration support through December 31, 2024.

4. **Termination Provisions:** Either party may terminate with 180 days written notice if specified performance benchmarks are not achieved.

#### Impact Assessment

This Agreement is expected to contribute approximately $125 million to $180 million in additional revenue over the contract period, representing 18-24% of the Company's projected total revenue for fiscal years 2024-2029.

The initial payment of $45,000,000 represents approximately 8.2% of the Company's total assets as of December 31, 2023 ($548,000,000).

**Board Approval Date:** March 11, 2024  
**Authorized Signatory:** Jennifer K. Morrison, Chief Executive Officer

---

*This disclosure is filed pursuant to applicable securities regulations.*

### DISCLOSURE OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |
| **Total Potential Value** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### Key Terms and Conditions

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

2. **Revenue Sharing:** Following the minimum guarantee period (24 months), the parties shall share net revenues on a 65/35 basis (Company/DataStream).

3. **Performance Milestones:** DataStream must deliver the core technology platform by September 30, 2024, with full integration support through December 31, 2024.

4. **Termination Provisions:** Either party may terminate with 180 days written notice if specified performance benchmarks are not achieved.

#### Impact Assessment

This Agreement is expected to contribute approximately $125 million to $180 million in additional revenue over the contract period, representing 18-24% of the Company's projected total revenue for fiscal years 2024-2029.

The initial payment of $45,000,000 represents approximately 8.2% of the Company's total assets as of December 31, 2023 ($548,000,000).

---

### DISCLOSURE OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |
| **Total Potential Value** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### Key Terms and Conditions

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

2. **Revenue Sharing:** Following the minimum guarantee period (24 months), the parties shall share net revenues on a 65/35 basis (Company/DataStream).

3. **Performance Milestones:** DataStream must deliver the core technology platform by September 30, 2024, with full integration support through December 31, 2024.

4. **Termination Provisions:** Either party may terminate with 180 days written notice if specified performance benchmarks are not achieved.

#### Impact Assessment

This Agreement is expected to contribute approximately $125 million to $180 million in additional revenue over the contract period, representing 18-24% of the Company's projected total revenue for fiscal years 2024-2029.

The initial payment of $45,000,000 represents approximately 8.2% of the Company's total assets as of December 31, 2023 ($548,000,000).

# REGULATORY DISCLOSURE FILING

## Material Business Agreement Notification

**Filing Date:** March 15, 2024  
**Report Type:** Material Contract Disclosure  
**Filing Entity:** TechVenture Global Inc.  
**Stock Code:** TVGI-5820

---

### DISCLOSURE OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |
| **Total Potential Value** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### Key Terms and Conditions

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

2. **Revenue Sharing:** Following the minimum guarantee period (24 months), the parties shall share net revenues on a 65/35 basis (Company/DataStream).

3. **Performance Milestones:** DataStream must deliver the core technology platform by September 30, 2024, with full integration support through December 31, 2024.

4. **Termination Provisions:** Either party may terminate with 180 days written notice if specified performance benchmarks are not achieved.

#### Impact Assessment

This Agreement is expected to contribute approximately $125 million to $180 million in additional revenue over the contract period, representing 18-24% of the Company's projected total revenue for fiscal years 2024-2029.

### DISCLOSURE OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

TechVenture Global Inc. (the "Company") hereby discloses the execution of a Material Business Agreement with DataStream Solutions Ltd., a Delaware corporation, entered into on March 12, 2024.

#### Transaction Overview

The Company has entered into a five-year Strategic Technology Partnership and Licensing Agreement (the "Agreement") with DataStream Solutions Ltd. ("DataStream") for the development and commercialization of advanced artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions.

#### Financial Terms

| Component | Amount (USD) | Payment Schedule |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Initial License Fee | $45,000,000 | Due upon execution |
| Development Milestone Payment | $22,500,000 | Q3 2024 |
| Annual Royalty (Minimum Guarantee) | $8,750,000 | Quarterly installments |
| Performance Bonus (Conditional) | Up to $15,000,000 | Upon achievement of revenue targets |
| **Total Potential Value** | **$91,250,000** | **2024-2029** |

#### Key Terms and Conditions

1. **Intellectual Property Rights:** The Company shall receive exclusive licensing rights for DataStream's proprietary AI optimization algorithms in the Asia-Pacific region, excluding mainland China.

2. **Revenue Sharing:** Following the minimum guarantee period (24 months), the parties shall share net revenues on a 65/35 basis (Company/DataStream).

4. **Termination Provisions:** Either party may terminate with 180 days written notice if specified performance benchmarks are not achieved.

This Agreement is expected to contribute approximately $125 million to $180 million in additional revenue over the contract period, representing 18-24% of the Company's projected total revenue for fiscal years 2024-2029.

สัญญาฉบับนี้คาดว่าจะสร้างรายได้เพิ่มเติมประมาณ $125 ล้านถึง $180 ล้านตลอดระยะเวลาสัญญา คิดเป็น 18-24% ของรายได้รวมที่คาดการณ์ของบริษัทสำหรับปีบัญชี 2567-2572

บริษัทได้ทำข้อตกลงความร่วมมือเชิงกลยุทธ์ด้านเทคโนโลยีและการให้สิทธิใช้งานระยะเวลา 5 ปี (“ข้อตกลง”) กับ DataStream Solutions Ltd. (“DataStream”) เพื่อพัฒนาและนำโซลูชันโครงสร้างพื้นฐานด้านปัญญาประดิษฐ์ขั้นสูงออกสู่เชิงพาณิชย์

#### เงื่อนไขทางการเงิน

| รายการ | จำนวนเงิน (ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ) | กำหนดการชำระเงิน |
|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| ค่าธรรมเนียมการให้สิทธิใช้งานเริ่มต้น | 45,000,000 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ | ชำระเมื่อมีการลงนาม |
| เงินชำระตามความสำเร็จของการพัฒนา | 22,500,000 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ | ไตรมาส 3 ปี 2024 |
| ค่าตอบแทนการใช้สิทธิรายปี (จำนวนเงินขั้นต่ำที่รับประกัน) | 8,750,000 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ | ชำระเป็นรายไตรมาส |
| โบนัสตามผลการดำเนินงาน (มีเงื่อนไข) | สูงสุด 15,000,000 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ | เมื่อบรรลุเป้าหมายรายได้ |
| **มูลค่ารวมที่อาจเกิดขึ้น** | **91,250,000 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ** | **2024-2029** |

#### ข้อกำหนดและเงื่อนไขสำคัญ

1. **สิทธิในทรัพย์สินทางปัญญา:** บริษัทจะได้รับสิทธิใช้งานแต่เพียงผู้เดียวสำหรับอัลกอริทึมเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพ AI อันเป็นกรรมสิทธิ์ของ DataStream ในภูมิภาคเอเชียแปซิฟิก ยกเว้นจีนแผ่นดินใหญ่

2. **การแบ่งรายได้:** ภายหลังระยะเวลาการรับประกันขั้นต่ำ (24 เดือน) คู่สัญญาจะแบ่งรายได้สุทธิในสัดส่วน 65/35 (บริษัท/DataStream)

3. **หลักเกณฑ์ความสำเร็จในการดำเนินงาน:** DataStream ต้องส่งมอบแพลตฟอร์มเทคโนโลยีหลักภายในวันที่ 30 กันยายน 2024 พร้อมให้การสนับสนุนการบูรณาการอย่างเต็มรูปแบบจนถึงวันที่ 31 ธันวาคม 2024

4. **ข้อกำหนดการบอกเลิก:** คู่สัญญาฝ่ายใดฝ่ายหนึ่งอาจบอกเลิกข้อตกลงได้โดยแจ้งเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษรล่วงหน้า 180 วัน หากไม่บรรลุเกณฑ์ผลการดำเนินงานที่กำหนด

#### การประเมินผลกระทบ

ข้อตกลงนี้คาดว่าจะสร้างรายได้เพิ่มเติมประมาณ 125 ล้านถึง 180 ล้านดอลลาร์สหรัฐตลอดระยะเวลาสัญญา คิดเป็น 18-24% ของรายได้รวมที่บริษัทคาดการณ์ไว้สำหรับปีงบการเงิน 2024-2029

เงินชำระเริ่มต้นจำนวน 45,000,000 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ คิดเป็นประมาณ 8.2% ของสินทรัพย์รวมของบริษัท ณ วันที่ 31 ธันวาคม 2023 (548,000,000 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ)

**วันที่คณะกรรมการอนุมัติ:** 11 มีนาคม 2024
