# Informe de Resultados Trimestrales - Grupo Financiero Santander México

**Período:** Tercer Trimestre 2023  
**Fecha de Publicación:** 27 de octubre de 2023

## Resumen Ejecutivo

Grupo Financiero Santander México, S.A.B. de C.V. presenta sus resultados correspondientes al tercer trimestre de 2023, demostrando un crecimiento sostenido en sus principales líneas de negocio. La institución financiera reportó un incremento significativo en la rentabilidad operativa, impulsado principalmente por el crecimiento en la cartera de crédito comercial y el segmento de banca personal.

## Resultados Financieros Consolidados

Durante el tercer trimestre de 2023, el banco registró ingresos totales por **$47,850 millones de pesos mexicanos (MXN)**, representando un aumento del 12.3% comparado con el mismo período del año anterior. El margen financiero alcanzó los $32,400 millones MXN, beneficiándose de las tasas de interés favorables y una gestión eficiente del portafolio crediticio.

### Desempeño Trimestral Comparativo

| Período | Ingresos Totales (MXN millones) | Utilidad Operativa (MXN millones) | Utilidad Neta (MXN millones) |
|---------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------|------------------------------|
| Q1 2023 | 43,250 | 18,900 | 12,450 |
| Q2 2023 | 45,680 | 20,150 | 13,280 |
| Q3 2023 | 47,850 | 21,730 | 14,620 |

## Análisis por Segmento

**Banca Minorista:** La cartera de crédito al consumo creció 8.7% trimestre contra trimestre, alcanzando $285,600 millones MXN. Las tarjetas de crédito mostraron particular dinamismo con un incremento del 11.2% en saldos promedio.

**Banca Corporativa:** Los préstamos comerciales aumentaron a $412,300 millones MXN, reflejando la confianza empresarial y la expansión económica sectorial. El índice de morosidad se mantuvo controlado en 1.8%.

**Gestión de Activos:** Los activos bajo administración crecieron hasta $156,900 millones MXN, con una captación neta positiva de $8,400 millones durante el trimestre.

## Perspectivas

La administración mantiene una perspectiva optimista para el cuarto trimestre de 2023, proyectando un crecimiento anual del ROE superior al 16.5% y manteniendo un índice de capitalización robusto del 15.2%.

# Quarterly Results Report - Grupo Financiero Santander México

**Period:** Third Quarter 2023  
**Publication Date:** October 27, 2023

## Executive Summary

Grupo Financiero Santander México, S.A.B. de C.V. presents its results for the third quarter of 2023, demonstrating sustained growth across its main business lines. The financial institution reported a significant increase in operating profitability, driven primarily by growth in the commercial loan portfolio and the retail banking segment.

## Consolidated Financial Results

During the third quarter of 2023, the bank recorded total revenues of **$47,850 million Mexican pesos (MXN)**, representing an increase of 12.3% compared with the same period of the previous year. The net interest margin reached $32,400 million MXN, benefiting from favorable interest rates and efficient credit portfolio management.

### Comparative Quarterly Performance

| Period  | Total Revenues (MXN millions) | Operating Income (MXN millions) | Net Income (MXN millions) |
|---------|-------------------------------|----------------------------------|---------------------------|
| Q1 2023 | 43,250 | 18,900 | 12,450 |
| Q2 2023 | 45,680 | 20,150 | 13,280 |
| Q3 2023 | 47,850 | 21,730 | 14,620 |

## Analysis by Segment

**Retail Banking:** The consumer loan portfolio grew 8.7% quarter over quarter, reaching $285,600 million MXN. Credit cards showed particular momentum with an 11.2% increase in average balances.

**Corporate Banking:** Commercial loans increased to $412,300 million MXN, reflecting business confidence and sectoral economic expansion. The non-performing loan ratio remained controlled at 1.8%.

**Asset Management:** Assets under management grew to $156,900 million MXN, with positive net inflows of $8,400 million during the quarter.

## Outlook

Management maintains an optimistic outlook for the fourth quarter of 2023, projecting annual ROE growth above 16.5% and maintaining a robust capitalization ratio of 15.2%.

# Rapport Trimestriel des Résultats - T3 2024

**Société Générale Technologie SA**  
Date de publication : 15 octobre 2024

## Synthèse des Performances Financières

La Société Générale Technologie SA annonce ses résultats pour le troisième trimestre de l'exercice 2024, démontrant une croissance soutenue malgré un environnement économique complexe. Le chiffre d'affaires consolidé atteint 487,3 millions d'euros, en hausse de 12,4% par rapport au T3 2023.

### Résultats Trimestriels Comparatifs

| Période | Chiffre d'Affaires (M€) | Résultat d'Exploitation (M€) | Résultat Net (M€) |
|---------|-------------------------|------------------------------|-------------------|
| T1 2024 | 445,8 | 67,2 | 48,9 |
| T2 2024 | 468,5 | 73,8 | 52,3 |
| T3 2024 | 487,3 | 81,4 | 58,7 |

## Analyse Détaillée

Le résultat d'exploitation s'établit à 81,4 millions d'euros, représentant une marge opérationnelle de 16,7%. Cette performance reflète l'efficacité de notre stratégie d'optimisation des coûts et l'expansion réussie dans les marchés européens.

Le résultat net part du groupe atteint 58,7 millions d'euros, soit une progression de 20,1% sur un an. Cette croissance est principalement attribuable à :

- L'augmentation des ventes dans le secteur des solutions cloud (+28%)
- La consolidation de notre filiale allemande TechnoSoft GmbH
- Une amélioration de la productivité opérationnelle de 3,2 points

### Perspectives pour le T4 2024

Le conseil d'administration prévoit un chiffre d'affaires compris entre 495 et 510 millions d'euros pour le quatrième trimestre. Les investissements en R&D seront maintenus à hauteur de 42 millions d'euros, conformément à notre plan stratégique 2024-2026.

La trésorerie nette s'élève à 234,6 millions d'euros au 30 septembre 2024, assurant une solidité financière permettant de poursuivre notre politique d'acquisitions ciblées.

# Quarterly Results Report - Q3 2024

**Société Générale Technologie SA**  
Publication date: 15 October 2024

## Financial Performance Summary

Société Générale Technologie SA announces its results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, demonstrating sustained growth despite a complex economic environment. Consolidated revenue reached €487.3 million, up 12.4% compared to Q3 2023.

### Comparative Quarterly Results

| Period | Revenue (€M) | Operating Income (€M) | Net Income (€M) |
|---------|-------------------------|------------------------------|-------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 445.8 | 67.2 | 48.9 |
| Q2 2024 | 468.5 | 73.8 | 52.3 |
| Q3 2024 | 487.3 | 81.4 | 58.7 |

## Detailed Analysis

Operating income stands at €81.4 million, representing an operating margin of 16.7%. This performance reflects the effectiveness of our cost optimization strategy and successful expansion in European markets.

Net income attributable to the group reached €58.7 million, an increase of 20.1% year-on-year. This growth is primarily attributable to:

- Increased sales in the cloud solutions sector (+28%)
- The consolidation of our German subsidiary TechnoSoft GmbH
- An improvement in operational productivity of 3.2 points

### Outlook for Q4 2024

The board of directors expects revenue between €495 and €510 million for the fourth quarter. R&D investments will be maintained at €42 million, in line with our 2024-2026 strategic plan.

Net cash stands at €234.6 million as of 30 September 2024, ensuring financial strength to continue our targeted acquisition policy.

**Investor Contact:** relations.investisseurs@sgt-tech.fr

# Conditions Générales - Compte Épargne Plus BNP Paribas

**Document contractuel en vigueur au 1er janvier 2024**

## Article 1 - Objet du contrat

Le présent contrat régit les relations entre BNP Paribas SA (ci-après « la Banque ») et le titulaire du Compte Épargne Plus (ci-après « le Client »).

## Article 2 - Conditions d'ouverture

2.1. Le montant minimum de dépôt initial est fixé à 150,00 EUR.

2.2. Le Client doit être majeur et résident fiscal français.

2.3. Un seul compte par personne physique est autorisé.

## Article 3 - Rémunération et taux d'intérêt

3.1. Le taux d'intérêt nominal annuel brut est de 3,25% pour les dépôts jusqu'à 50 000,00 EUR.

3.2. Au-delà de 50 000,00 EUR, le taux applicable est de 1,75%.

3.3. Les intérêts sont calculés par quinzaine et capitalisés annuellement au 31 décembre.

## Article 4 - Frais et commissions

| Type d'opération | Montant |
|-----------------|---------|
| Frais de tenue de compte | Gratuit |
| Virement sortant | 2,50 EUR |
| Clôture anticipée (moins de 12 mois) | 35,00 EUR |
| Relevé papier mensuel | 1,20 EUR |
| Carte de retrait optionnelle | 15,00 EUR/an |

## Article 5 - Opérations autorisées

5.1. Versements : minimum 50,00 EUR par opération, maximum 10 000,00 EUR par mois.

5.2. Retraits : autorisés sans pénalité après 3 mois, limités à 3 opérations par trimestre.

5.3. Tout retrait excédentaire entraîne des frais de 12,00 EUR par opération supplémentaire.

## Article 6 - Fiscalité

6.1. Les intérêts sont soumis au prélèvement forfaitaire unique (PFU) de 30% comprenant :
   - 12,8% d'impôt sur le revenu
   - 17,2% de prélèvements sociaux

6.2. Le Client peut opter pour le barème progressif de l'impôt sur le revenu.

## Article 7 - Durée et résiliation

7.1. Le contrat est conclu pour une durée indéterminée à compter du 15 janvier 2024.

7.2. Résiliation possible par lettre recommandée avec préavis de 30 jours calendaires.

# General Terms and Conditions - BNP Paribas Savings Plus Account

**Contractual document in force as of January 1, 2024**

## Article 1 - Purpose of the contract

This contract governs the relationship between BNP Paribas SA (hereinafter "the Bank") and the holder of the Savings Plus Account (hereinafter "the Client").

## Article 2 - Opening conditions

2.1. The minimum initial deposit amount is set at EUR 150.00.

2.2. The Client must be of legal age and a French tax resident.

2.3. Only one account per individual is authorized.

## Article 3 - Remuneration and interest rate

3.1. The gross annual nominal interest rate is 3.25% for deposits up to EUR 50,000.00.

3.2. Above EUR 50,000.00, the applicable rate is 1.75%.

3.3. Interest is calculated fortnightly and compounded annually on December 31.

## Article 4 - Fees and charges

| Type of transaction | Amount |
|-----------------|---------|
| Account maintenance fee | Free |
| Outgoing transfer | EUR 2.50 |
| Early closure (less than 12 months) | EUR 35.00 |
| Monthly paper statement | EUR 1.20 |
| Optional withdrawal card | EUR 15.00/year |

## Article 5 - Authorized transactions

5.1. Deposits: minimum EUR 50.00 per transaction, maximum EUR 10,000.00 per month.

5.2. Withdrawals: authorized without penalty after 3 months, limited to 3 transactions per quarter.

5.3. Any excess withdrawal incurs fees of EUR 12.00 per additional transaction.

## Article 6 - Taxation

6.1. Interest is subject to the flat-rate withholding tax (PFU) of 30% comprising:
   - 12.8% income tax
   - 17.2% social security contributions

6.2. The Client may opt for the progressive income tax scale.

## Article 7 - Term and termination

7.1. The contract is entered into for an indefinite period starting from January 15, 2024.

7.2. Termination possible by registered letter with 30 calendar days' notice.

# Fonds Commun de Placement Horizon Europe Croissance

## Description du Produit

Le Fonds Horizon Europe Croissance (Code ISIN: FR0013456789) est un OPCVM de droit français géré par la société de gestion Patrimoine Capital Management, agréée par l'Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) sous le numéro GP-2018-0042. Ce fonds a été créé le 15 mars 2019 avec pour objectif de réaliser une performance supérieure à l'indice MSCI Europe sur un horizon d'investissement recommandé de 5 ans minimum.

## Stratégie d'Investissement

Le fonds investit principalement dans des actions de sociétés européennes à forte capitalisation boursière, avec une exposition minimale de 75% aux marchés actions de la zone euro et du Royaume-Uni. Le portefeuille est composé d'environ 45 à 60 valeurs sélectionnées pour leur potentiel de croissance et leur solidité financière. Les principaux secteurs représentés incluent la technologie (28%), la santé (22%), les biens de consommation (18%) et les services financiers (15%).

La valeur liquidative est calculée quotidiennement et publiée sur le site www.patrimoine-capital.fr. Au 31 décembre 2023, l'actif net du fonds s'élevait à 487,3 millions d'euros, réparti sur 2,4 millions de parts.

## Frais et Commissions

| Type de Frais | Taux |
|--------------|------|
| Frais d'entrée maximum | 2,50% |
| Frais de sortie | 0,00% |
| Frais de gestion annuels | 1,85% |
| Commission de surperformance | 20% au-delà de l'indice de référence |
| Frais courants (2023) | 2,12% |

## Performance Historique Annuelle

| Année | Performance du Fonds | Indice MSCI Europe |
|-------|---------------------|-------------------|
| 2023 | +12,4% | +11,8% |
| 2022 | -8,7% | -9,5% |
| 2021 | +18,3% | +16,2% |
| 2020 | +3,2% | +2,8% |
| 2019 | +15,6% | +14,1% |

**Souscription minimale initiale:** 1 000 euros  
**Souscriptions ultérieures:** 100 euros minimum

## Avertissement sur les Risques

**Attention:** Les performances passées ne préjugent pas des performances futures. La valeur de votre investissement peut fluctuer à la hausse comme à la baisse, et vous pourriez ne pas récupérer le montant initialement investi. Ce fonds présente un risque de perte en capital. Le niveau de risque sur l'échelle SRRI (Synthetic Risk and Reward Indicator) est de 5 sur 7, reflétant une volatilité importante liée à l'exposition aux marchés actions européens. Les investisseurs doivent également tenir compte du risque de change pour les positions hors zone euro, du risque de liquidité en cas de conditions de marché défavorables, et du risque lié à la gestion discrétionnaire du portefeuille.

# Horizon Europe Growth Mutual Fund

## Product Description

The Horizon Europe Growth Fund (ISIN Code: FR0013456789) is a French UCITS managed by the management company Patrimoine Capital Management, authorized by the Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) under number GP-2018-0042. This fund was created on March 15, 2019 with the objective of achieving performance superior to the MSCI Europe index over a recommended investment horizon of at least 5 years.

## Investment Strategy

The fund invests primarily in shares of European large-cap companies, with a minimum exposure of 75% to equity markets in the euro zone and the United Kingdom. The portfolio is composed of approximately 45 to 60 securities selected for their growth potential and financial strength. The main sectors represented include technology (28%), healthcare (22%), consumer goods (18%), and financial services (15%).

The net asset value is calculated daily and published on the website www.patrimoine-capital.fr. As of December 31, 2023, the fund's net assets amounted to 487.3 million euros, divided into 2.4 million shares.

## Fees and Charges

| Type of Fee | Rate |
|--------------|------|
| Maximum entry fee | 2.50% |
| Exit fee | 0.00% |
| Annual management fees | 1.85% |
| Performance fee | 20% above the benchmark index |
| Ongoing charges (2023) | 2.12% |

## Annual Historical Performance

| Year | Fund Performance | MSCI Europe Index |
|-------|---------------------|-------------------|
| 2023 | +12.4% | +11.8% |
| 2022 | -8.7% | -9.5% |
| 2021 | +18.3% | +16.2% |
| 2020 | +3.2% | +2.8% |
| 2019 | +15.6% | +14.1% |

**Minimum initial subscription:** 1,000 euros  
**Subsequent subscriptions:** 100 euros minimum

## Risk Warning

**Warning:** Past performance is not indicative of future performance. The value of your investment may fluctuate upward or downward, and you may not recover the amount initially invested. This fund presents a risk of capital loss. The risk level on the SRRI (Synthetic Risk and Reward Indicator) scale is 5 out of 7, reflecting significant volatility related to exposure to European equity markets. Investors must also take into account currency risk for positions outside the euro zone, liquidity risk in the event of unfavorable market conditions, and risk related to discretionary portfolio management.

The Horizon Europe Croissance Fund (ISIN: FR0013456789) is a French-law UCITS managed by Patrimoine Capital Management, a management company authorized by the Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) under number GP-2018-0042. The fund was established on March 15, 2019, with the objective of outperforming the MSCI Europe Index over a recommended investment horizon of at least 5 years.

## Investment Strategy

The fund invests primarily in shares of large-cap European companies, with a minimum exposure of 75% to equity markets in the euro area and the United Kingdom. The portfolio comprises approximately 45 to 60 securities selected for their growth potential and financial strength. The main sectors represented include technology (28%), healthcare (22%), consumer goods (18%), and financial services (15%).

The net asset value is calculated daily and published on www.patrimoine-capital.fr. As of December 31, 2023, the fund's net assets amounted to €487.3 million, spread across 2.4 million units.

| Fee Type | Rate |
|--------------|------|
| Maximum entry charge | 2.50% |
| Exit charge | 0.00% |
| Annual management fee | 1.85% |
| Performance fee | 20% of outperformance relative to the benchmark index |
| Ongoing charges (2023) | 2.12% |

| Year | Fund Performance | MSCI Europe Index |
|-------|---------------------|-------------------|
| 2023 | +12.4% | +11.8% |

| 2021 | +18.3% | +16.2% |

| 2019 | +15.6% | +14.1% |

**Minimum initial subscription:** €1,000  
**Subsequent subscriptions:** €100 minimum

**Warning:** Past performance is not indicative of future performance. The value of your investment may rise or fall, and you may not recover the amount originally invested. # Rapport Trimestriel des Résultats - T3 2024

**Société Générale Technologie SA**  
Date de publication : 15 octobre 2024

## Synthèse des Performances Financières

La Société Générale Technologie SA annonce ses résultats pour le troisième trimestre de l'exercice 2024, démontrant une croissance soutenue malgré un environnement économique complexe. Le chiffre d'affaires consolidé atteint 487,3 millions d'euros, en hausse de 12,4% par rapport au T3 2023.

### Résultats Trimestriels Comparatifs

| Période | Chiffre d'Affaires (M€) | Résultat d'Exploitation (M€) | Résultat Net (M€) |
|---------|-------------------------|------------------------------|-------------------|
| T1 2024 | 445,8 | 67,2 | 48,9 |
| T2 2024 | 468,5 | 73,8 | 52,3 |
| T3 2024 | 487,3 | 81,4 | 58,7 |

## Analyse Détaillée

Le résultat d'exploitation s'établit à 81,4 millions d'euros, représentant une marge opérationnelle de 16,7%. Cette performance reflète l'efficacité de notre stratégie d'optimisation des coûts et l'expansion réussie dans les marchés européens.

Le résultat net part du groupe atteint 58,7 millions d'euros, soit une progression de 20,1% sur un an. Cette croissance est principalement attribuable à :

- L'augmentation des ventes dans le secteur des solutions cloud (+28%)
- La consolidation de notre filiale allemande TechnoSoft GmbH
- Une amélioration de la productivité opérationnelle de 3,2 points

### Perspectives pour le T4 2024

Le conseil d'administration prévoit un chiffre d'affaires compris entre 495 et 510 millions d'euros pour le quatrième trimestre. Les investissements en R&D seront maintenus à hauteur de 42 millions d'euros, conformément à notre plan stratégique 2024-2026.

La trésorerie nette s'élève à 234,6 millions d'euros au 30 septembre 2024, assurant une solidité financière permettant de poursuivre notre politique d'acquisitions ciblées.

**Contact Investisseurs :** relations.investisseurs@sgt-tech.fr

# Quarterly Results Report - Q3 2024

**Société Générale Technologie SA**  
Publication date: 15 October 2024

## Financial Performance Summary

Société Générale Technologie SA announces its results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, demonstrating sustained growth despite a complex economic environment. Consolidated revenue reached €487.3 million, up 12.4% compared to Q3 2023.

### Comparative Quarterly Results

| Period | Revenue (€M) | Operating Income (€M) | Net Income (€M) |
|---------|-------------------------|------------------------------|-------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 445.8 | 67.2 | 48.9 |
| Q2 2024 | 468.5 | 73.8 | 52.3 |
| Q3 2024 | 487.3 | 81.4 | 58.7 |

## Detailed Analysis

Operating income stands at €81.4 million, representing an operating margin of 16.7%. This performance reflects the effectiveness of our cost optimization strategy and successful expansion in European markets.

Net income attributable to the group reached €58.7 million, an increase of 20.1% year-on-year. This growth is primarily attributable to:

- Increased sales in the cloud solutions sector (+28%)
- The consolidation of our German subsidiary TechnoSoft GmbH
- An improvement in operational productivity of 3.2 points

### Outlook for Q4 2024

The board of directors expects revenue of between €495 and €510 million for the fourth quarter. R&D investments will be maintained at €42 million, in line with our 2024-2026 strategic plan.

Net cash stands at €234.6 million as of 30 September 2024, ensuring financial strength to continue our targeted acquisition policy.

**Investor Contact:** relations.investisseurs@sgt-tech.fr

# Quarterly Income Statement - Financial Year 2023-24

**Company:** Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)  
**Reporting Period:** Third Quarter (October-December 2023)  
**Issue Date:** 15 January 2024

## Executive Summary

Bharat Electronics Limited has recorded excellent performance in the third quarter of financial year 2023-24. The company's total revenue stood at ₹4,850 crore, reflecting a growth of 12.3% compared to the previous quarter. This positive result was achieved due to growth in defence contracts and strong presence in export markets.

## Financial Performance Analysis

### Comparative Statement of Last Three Quarters

| Financial Parameter | Q1 FY24 (April-June) | Q2 FY24 (July-September) | Q3 FY24 (October-December) |
|----------------|---------------------|----------------------|------------------------|
| **Total Revenue (₹ crore)** | 3,920 | 4,320 | 4,850 |
| **Operating Profit (₹ crore)** | 685 | 756 | 873 |
| **Net Profit (₹ crore)** | 512 | 568 | 654 |
| **EBITDA Margin (%)** | 17.5% | 17.5% | 18.0% |

### Key Achievements

1. **Revenue Growth:** Total revenue in the third quarter reached ₹4,850 crore, representing a growth of 23.7% on a year-on-year basis.

2. **Operating Efficiency:** Operating profit margin remained stable at 18.0%, reflecting improved cost management.

3. **Net Profit:** Net profit stood at ₹654 crore, which is 15.1% higher compared to Q2.

4. **New Contracts:** New defence contracts worth ₹8,500 crore were secured during the quarter.

## Segment-wise Performance

The Defence Electronics division contributed 68% of total revenue, while the share of civilian products remained at 32%. Export revenue stood at ₹720 crore, which is 14.8% of total revenue.

## Future Plans

The company targets revenue of ₹5,200 crore in the next quarter and is planning to invest ₹450 crore in new technologies.

| विवरण | अधिग्रहण से पूर्व | अधिग्रहण के पश्चात |

**निपटान तिथि:** 14 मार्च 2024

Mr. Rajesh Kumar Gupta and his associate entity Gupta Holdings Private Limited have acquired a total of 2,45,00,000 (two crore forty-five lakh) equity shares through open market transactions dated 12 March 2024. This acquisition was made at an average price of ₹847.50 per share.

# एचडीएफसी बैंक व्यक्तिगत ऋण नियम एवं शर्तें

**दस्तावेज़ संख्या:** HDFC/PL/2024/00789  
**जारी तिथि:** 15 जनवरी 2024

## अनुच्छेद 1: ऋण राशि एवं ब्याज दर

1.1 ऋणकर्ता को अधिकतम ₹15,00,000 (पंद्रह लाख रुपये) तक का व्यक्तिगत ऋण स्वीकृत किया जाएगा।

1.2 वार्षिक ब्याज दर 10.75% से 18.50% के बीच होगी, जो ऋणकर्ता की क्रेडिट रेटिंग पर निर्भर करेगी।

1.3 ऋण अवधि न्यूनतम 12 महीने और अधिकतम 60 महीने होगी।

## अनुच्छेद 2: शुल्क एवं प्रभार

| शुल्क का प्रकार | राशि/प्रतिशत |
|-----------------|--------------|
| प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क | ऋण राशि का 2.5% + GST |
| पूर्व भुगतान शुल्क | बकाया राशि का 4% (12 महीने के भीतर) |
| विलंब शुल्क | ₹750 प्रति माह + 2% प्रति माह अतिरिक्त ब्याज |
| चेक बाउंस शुल्क | ₹500 प्रति घटना |
| ऋण रद्दीकरण शुल्क | ₹3,000 + GST |

## अनुच्छेद 3: पुनर्भुगतान शर्तें

3.1 मासिक किस्त (EMI) प्रत्येक माह की 5 तारीख को देय होगी।

3.2 भुगतान ECS, NACH, या ऑनलाइन बैंकिंग के माध्यम से किया जा सकता है।

3.3 यदि EMI तिथि से 7 दिनों के भीतर भुगतान नहीं किया जाता है, तो विलंब शुल्क लागू होगा।

# HDFC Bank Personal Loan Terms and Conditions

**Document Number:** HDFC/PL/2024/00789  
**Issue Date:** 15 January 2024

## Article 1: Loan Amount and Interest Rate

1.1 The borrower shall be sanctioned a personal loan of up to ₹15,00,000 (Fifteen Lakh Rupees).

1.2 The annual interest rate shall be between 10.75% and 18.50%, depending on the borrower's credit rating.

1.3 The loan tenure shall be a minimum of 12 months and a maximum of 60 months.

## Article 2: Fees and Charges

| Type of Fee | Amount/Percentage |
|------------|------------------|
| Processing Fee | 2.5% of loan amount + GST |
| Prepayment Charge | 4% of outstanding amount (within 12 months) |
| Late Payment Fee | ₹750 per month + 2% per month additional interest |
| Cheque Bounce Charge | ₹500 per incident |
| Loan Cancellation Fee | ₹3,000 + GST |

## Article 3: Repayment Terms

3.1 The monthly instalment (EMI) shall be payable on the 5th of each month.

3.2 Payment may be made through ECS, NACH, or online banking.

3.3 If payment is not made within 7 days from the EMI date, late payment fee shall apply.

## Article 4: Event of Default

4.1 Upon missing 3 consecutive EMIs, the loan account shall be declared as NPA (Non-Performing Asset).

4.2 The Bank shall have the right to recover the entire outstanding amount immediately.

4.3 In the event of default, CIBIL and other credit bureaus shall be notified.

## Article 5: Insurance and Security

5.1 The borrower is required to obtain life insurance cover for loans exceeding ₹5,00,000.

5.2 The insurance premium shall be borne by the borrower.

**Acceptance:** By signing this document, the borrower accepts all the above terms and conditions.

# म्यूचुअल फंड उत्पाद विवरण

## भारत विकास इक्विटी फंड - सीरीज़ A

**फंड कोड:** BVEF-2024-A  
**लॉन्च तिथि:** 15 जनवरी 2019  
**फंड प्रबंधक:** आदित्य कपूर और प्रिया शर्मा  
**एसेट मैनेजमेंट कंपनी:** भारत विकास एसेट मैनेजमेंट लिमिटेड

### फंड का उद्देश्य

यह फंड मुख्य रूप से भारतीय इक्विटी बाजारों में निवेश करके दीर्घकालिक पूंजी वृद्धि प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य रखता है। फंड का पोर्टफोलियो लार्ज-कैप और मिड-कैप कंपनियों में 70:30 के अनुपात में निवेशित है। वर्तमान में फंड का कुल एयूएम (AUM) ₹4,250 करोड़ है।

### निवेश विवरण

**न्यूनतम निवेश राशि:** ₹5,000  
**अतिरिक्त निवेश:** ₹1,000  
**एसआईपी सुविधा:** उपलब्ध (न्यूनतम ₹500 प्रति माह)  
**लॉक-इन अवधि:** कोई नहीं  
**बेंचमार्क:** निफ्टी 50 और निफ्टी मिडकैप 150 का संयुक्त सूचकांक

### शुल्क संरचना

| शुल्क का प्रकार | दर |
|-----------------|-----|
| प्रवेश भार (Entry Load) | शून्य |
| निकास भार (Exit Load) | 1 वर्ष से पहले निकासी पर 1% |
| व्यय अनुपात (Expense Ratio) | 2.15% प्रति वर्ष |
| फंड प्रबंधन शुल्क | 1.50% प्रति वर्ष |
| लेनदेन शुल्क | ₹100 प्रति लेनदेन (₹10,000 से अधिक के लिए) |

### ऐतिहासिक वार्षिक रिटर्न

| वित्तीय वर्ष | रिटर्न (%) | बेंचमार्क रिटर्न (%) |
|-------------|-----------|---------------------|
| 2023-24 | 18.45% | 16.20% |
| 2022-23 | 12.80% | 11.50% |
| 2021-22 | 22.35% | 19.75% |
| 2020-21 | 15.60% | 14.30% |
| 2019-20 | -8.25% | -9.50% |

### जोखिम प्रकटीकरण

**महत्वपूर्ण:** म्यूचुअल फंड निवेश बाजार जोखिमों के अधीन हैं। कृपया निवेश करने से पहले सभी योजना संबंधित दस्तावेजों को ध्यान से पढ़ें। पिछला प्रदर्शन भविष्य के रिटर्न की गारंटी नहीं है। इस फंड में उच्च जोखिम है क्योंकि यह मुख्य रूप से इक्विटी में निवेश करता है। निवेशकों को बाजार की अस्थिरता के कारण मूलधन की हानि का जोखिम हो सकता है। यह उत्पाद उन निवेशकों के लिए उपयुक्त है जो 5 वर्ष या उससे अधिक की निवेश अवधि के साथ उच्च जोखिम सहन कर सकते हैं।

# त्रैमासिक आय विवरण - वित्तीय वर्ष 2023-24

**कंपनी:** भारत इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स लिमिटेड (BEL)  
**रिपोर्ट अवधि:** तीसरी तिमाही (अक्टूबर-दिसंबर 2023)  
**जारी तिथि:** 15 जनवरी 2024

## कार्यकारी सारांश

भारत इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स लिमिटेड ने वित्तीय वर्ष 2023-24 की तीसरी तिमाही में उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन दर्ज किया है। कंपनी का कुल राजस्व ₹4,850 करोड़ रहा, जो पिछली तिमाही की तुलना में 12.3% की वृद्धि दर्शाता है। रक्षा अनुबंधों में वृद्धि और निर्यात बाजार में मजबूत उपस्थिति के कारण यह सकारात्मक परिणाम प्राप्त हुआ।

## वित्तीय प्रदर्शन विश्लेषण

### तिमाही तुलनात्मक विवरण

| वित्तीय मापदंड | Q1 2023-24 (अप्रैल-जून) | Q2 2023-24 (जुलाई-सितंबर) | Q3 2023-24 (अक्टूबर-दिसंबर) |
|----------------|------------------------|--------------------------|----------------------------|
| **कुल राजस्व (₹ करोड़)** | 3,920 | 4,320 | 4,850 |
| **परिचालन लाभ (₹ करोड़)** | 685 | 756 | 873 |
| **शुद्ध लाभ (₹ करोड़)** | 512 | 568 | 654 |
| **EBITDA मार्जिन (%)** | 17.5% | 17.5% | 18.0% |

### मुख्य उपलब्धियां

1. **राजस्व वृद्धि:** तीसरी तिमाही में कुल राजस्व ₹4,850 करोड़ तक पहुंच गया, जो वर्ष-दर-वर्ष आधार पर 23.7% की वृद्धि है।

**Reporting Period:** Third Quarter (October-December 2023)  
**Issue Date:** 15 January 2024

## Executive Summary

Bharat Electronics Limited has recorded excellent performance in the third quarter of financial year 2023-24. The company's total revenue stood at ₹4,850 crore, reflecting a growth of 12.3% compared to the previous quarter. This positive result was achieved due to growth in defence contracts and strong presence in export markets.

| **Operating Profit (₹ crore)** | 685 | 756 | 873 |
| **Net Profit (₹ crore)** | 512 | 568 | 654 |
| **EBITDA Margin (%)** | 17.5% | 17.5% | 18.0% |

The company is planning to launch new products and expand into international markets in the next quarter.

# Laporan Keuangan Kuartal III 2023
## PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia

**Jakarta, 15 Oktober 2023** - PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia (MSTI) mengumumkan hasil kinerja keuangan untuk kuartal ketiga tahun 2023 yang menunjukkan pertumbuhan signifikan di semua lini bisnis.

### Ringkasan Kinerja Keuangan

Perusahaan mencatat pendapatan konsolidasi sebesar Rp 2,45 triliun pada Q3 2023, meningkat 18,5% dibandingkan kuartal sebelumnya. Pertumbuhan ini didorong oleh ekspansi layanan cloud computing dan solusi digital untuk sektor perbankan dan ritel.

Laba operasional mencapai Rp 687 miliar, naik 22,3% dari Q2 2023, mencerminkan efisiensi operasional yang lebih baik dan margin keuntungan yang meningkat. Laba bersih perusahaan tercatat Rp 512 miliar, tumbuh 19,8% secara quarter-on-quarter.

### Tabel Kinerja Keuangan Tiga Kuartal Terakhir

| Indikator | Q1 2023 | Q2 2023 | Q3 2023 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|
| **Pendapatan (Rp Miliar)** | 1.856 | 2.067 | 2.450 |
| **Laba Operasional (Rp Miliar)** | 498 | 562 | 687 |
| **Laba Bersih (Rp Miliar)** | 371 | 427 | 512 |
| **Margin Laba Operasional (%)** | 26,8 | 27,2 | 28,0 |
| **Margin Laba Bersih (%)** | 20,0 | 20,7 | 20,9 |

### Analisis Segmen Bisnis

Divisi Cloud & Infrastructure Services menyumbang 58% dari total pendapatan dengan nilai Rp 1,42 triliun. Sementara itu, segmen Digital Solutions mencatatkan pertumbuhan tertinggi sebesar 35% YoY dengan pendapatan Rp 735 miliar.

Direktur Utama MSTI, Bapak Andrian Wijaya, menyatakan: "Kinerja Q3 2023 mencerminkan komitmen kami dalam memberikan solusi teknologi terdepan. Kami optimis dapat mempertahankan momentum pertumbuhan ini hingga akhir tahun dengan target pendapatan tahunan mencapai Rp 9,2 triliun."

### Proyeksi dan Outlook

Manajemen memproyeksikan pertumbuhan pendapatan sebesar 15-20% untuk Q4 2023, didukung oleh pipeline proyek senilai Rp 3,1 triliun dan ekspansi ke 12 kota baru di Indonesia.

# Q3 2023 Financial Report
## PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia

**Jakarta, October 15, 2023** - PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia (MSTI) announces its financial performance results for the third quarter of 2023, showing significant growth across all business lines.

### Financial Performance Summary

The Company recorded consolidated revenue of Rp 2.45 trillion in Q3 2023, an increase of 18.5% compared to the previous quarter. This growth was driven by the expansion of cloud computing services and digital solutions for the banking and retail sectors.

Operating profit reached Rp 687 billion, up 22.3% from Q2 2023, reflecting improved operational efficiency and increased profit margins. The Company's net profit was recorded at Rp 512 billion, growing 19.8% on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

### Financial Performance Table for the Last Three Quarters

| Indicator | Q1 2023 | Q2 2023 | Q3 2023 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|
| **Revenue (Rp Billion)** | 1,856 | 2,067 | 2,450 |
| **Operating Profit (Rp Billion)** | 498 | 562 | 687 |
| **Net Profit (Rp Billion)** | 371 | 427 | 512 |
| **Operating Profit Margin (%)** | 26.8 | 27.2 | 28.0 |
| **Net Profit Margin (%)** | 20.0 | 20.7 | 20.9 |

### Business Segment Analysis

The Cloud & Infrastructure Services division contributed 58% of total revenue with a value of Rp 1.42 trillion. Meanwhile, the Digital Solutions segment recorded the highest growth of 35% YoY with revenue of Rp 735 billion.

MSTI's President Director, Mr. Andrian Wijaya, stated: "Q3 2023 performance reflects our commitment to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions. We are optimistic about maintaining this growth momentum through year-end with an annual revenue target of Rp 9.2 trillion."

### Projections and Outlook

Management projects revenue growth of 15-20% for Q4 2023, supported by a project pipeline worth Rp 3.1 trillion and expansion into 12 new cities in Indonesia.

# SYARAT DAN KETENTUAN KARTU KREDIT PLATINUM PT BANK NUSANTARA SEJAHTERA

**Berlaku efektif: 1 Januari 2024**

## PASAL 1: KETENTUAN UMUM

1.1 Kartu Kredit Platinum PT Bank Nusantara Sejahtera ("Bank") diterbitkan untuk nasabah yang memenuhi persyaratan dengan limit kredit minimum Rp 15.000.000 (lima belas juta rupiah).

1.2 Pemegang kartu wajib membayar iuran tahunan sebesar Rp 750.000 (tujuh ratus lima puluh ribu rupiah) untuk kartu utama dan Rp 375.000 (tiga ratus tujuh puluh lima ribu rupiah) untuk kartu tambahan.

## PASAL 2: BIAYA DAN BUNGA

2.1 Suku bunga yang dikenakan adalah 2,25% per bulan atau 27% per tahun untuk transaksi ritel dan 2,95% per bulan atau 35,4% per tahun untuk transaksi tarik tunai.

2.2 Biaya keterlambatan pembayaran:

| Jumlah Tagihan | Biaya Keterlambatan |
|---|---|
| Rp 0 - Rp 5.000.000 | Rp 150.000 |
| Rp 5.000.001 - Rp 20.000.000 | Rp 250.000 |
| > Rp 20.000.000 | Rp 400.000 |

2.3 Biaya tarik tunai sebesar 4% dari jumlah penarikan dengan minimum Rp 75.000.

2.4 Biaya transaksi luar negeri dikenakan sebesar 3,5% dari nilai transaksi dalam mata uang asing.

## PASAL 3: PEMBAYARAN

3.1 Pembayaran minimum adalah 10% dari total tagihan atau Rp 100.000, mana yang lebih besar.

3.2 Tanggal jatuh tempo pembayaran adalah 20 hari setelah tanggal cetak tagihan.

3.3 Pembayaran dapat dilakukan melalui transfer bank, ATM, mobile banking, atau kantor cabang Bank.

## PASAL 4: PROGRAM REWARD

4.1 Setiap transaksi Rp 10.000 akan mendapatkan 1 poin reward.

4.2 Poin reward berlaku selama 24 bulan sejak tanggal transaksi.

4.3 Minimum penukaran poin adalah 5.000 poin.

## PASAL 5: PENUTUPAN KARTU

5.1 Bank berhak menutup kartu tanpa pemberitahuan terlebih dahulu jika terjadi tunggakan lebih dari 90 hari.

5.2 Biaya penutupan kartu atas permintaan nasabah adalah Rp 100.000.

**PT Bank Nusantara Sejahtera**  
Terdaftar dan diawasi oleh Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK)  
Kantor Pusat: Jl. Sudirman Kav. 52-53, Jakarta Selatan 12190

# TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF PT BANK NUSANTARA SEJAHTERA PLATINUM CREDIT CARD

**Effective date: January 1, 2024**

## ARTICLE 1: GENERAL PROVISIONS

1.1 The PT Bank Nusantara Sejahtera ("Bank") Platinum Credit Card is issued to customers who meet the requirements with a minimum credit limit of Rp 15,000,000 (fifteen million rupiah).

1.2 Cardholders are required to pay an annual fee of Rp 750,000 (seven hundred fifty thousand rupiah) for the principal card and Rp 375,000 (three hundred seventy-five thousand rupiah) for the supplementary card.

## ARTICLE 2: FEES AND INTEREST

2.1 The interest rate charged is 2.25% per month or 27% per annum for retail transactions and 2.95% per month or 35.4% per annum for cash advance transactions.

2.2 Late payment fees:

| Billing Amount | Late Payment Fee |
|---|---|
| Rp 0 - Rp 5,000,000 | Rp 150,000 |
| Rp 5,000,001 - Rp 20,000,000 | Rp 250,000 |
| > Rp 20,000,000 | Rp 400,000 |

2.3 Cash advance fee of 4% of the withdrawal amount with a minimum of Rp 75,000.

2.4 Foreign transaction fee charged at 3.5% of the transaction value in foreign currency.

## ARTICLE 3: PAYMENT

3.1 The minimum payment is 10% of the total billing amount or Rp 100,000, whichever is greater.

3.2 The payment due date is 20 days after the statement date.

3.3 Payment may be made through bank transfer, ATM, mobile banking, or Bank branch offices.

## ARTICLE 4: REWARD PROGRAM

4.1 Every Rp 10,000 transaction will earn 1 reward point.

4.2 Reward points are valid for 24 months from the transaction date.

4.3 Minimum point redemption is 5,000 points.

## ARTICLE 5: CARD CLOSURE

5.1 The Bank reserves the right to close the card without prior notice if arrears exceed 90 days.

5.2 Card closure fee upon customer request is Rp 100,000.

**PT Bank Nusantara Sejahtera**  
Registered and supervised by the Financial Services Authority (OJK)  
Head Office: Jl. Sudirman Kav. 52-53, South Jakarta 12190

# Deskripsi Produk Reksa Dana Saham Nusantara Sejahtera

**Manajer Investasi:** PT Astra Capital Management Indonesia  
**Bank Kustodian:** Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk  
**Tanggal Peluncuran:** 15 Maret 2019  
**Nilai Aktiva Bersih (NAB) per Unit:** Rp 2.847,50 (per 31 Desember 2024)

## Tujuan Investasi

Reksa Dana Saham Nusantara Sejahtera bertujuan untuk memberikan pertumbuhan modal jangka panjang melalui investasi pada efek ekuitas yang tercatat di Bursa Efek Indonesia. Dana ini mengalokasikan minimum 80% dari total aset pada saham-saham perusahaan berkualitas tinggi dengan kapitalisasi pasar besar dan menengah.

## Komposisi Portofolio

Portofolio dana ini terdiversifikasi di berbagai sektor, termasuk:
- Perbankan: 28%
- Teknologi dan Telekomunikasi: 22%
- Konsumen: 18%
- Energi dan Pertambangan: 15%
- Infrastruktur: 12%
- Instrumen Pasar Uang: 5%

## Struktur Biaya

| Jenis Biaya | Persentase |
|-------------|------------|
| Biaya Pembelian (Subscription Fee) | Maksimal 2,00% |
| Biaya Penjualan Kembali (Redemption Fee) | Maksimal 1,00% |
| Biaya Pengalihan (Switching Fee) | Maksimal 0,50% |
| Biaya Pengelolaan Investasi (Management Fee) | Maksimal 2,50% per tahun |
| Biaya Bank Kustodian | Maksimal 0,25% per tahun |

## Kinerja Historis Tahunan

| Tahun | Return (%) | IHSG (%) |
|-------|-----------|----------|
| 2024 | 18,45% | 15,20% |
| 2023 | 12,30% | 10,45% |
| 2022 | 8,75% | 4,09% |
| 2021 | 15,60% | 10,83% |
| 2020 | -3,25% | -5,09% |

**Investasi Minimum:** Rp 100.000 (pembelian awal)  
**Investasi Minimum Tambahan:** Rp 50.000

## Pengungkapan Risiko

INVESTASI MELALUI REKSA DANA MENGANDUNG RISIKO. Calon investor wajib membaca dan memahami prospektus sebelum memutuskan untuk berinvestasi. Kinerja masa lalu tidak mencerminkan kinerja masa depan. Risiko investasi ditanggung sepenuhnya oleh investor, termasuk namun tidak terbatas pada risiko penurunan Nilai Aktiva Bersih (NAB), risiko likuiditas, risiko pasar, risiko wanprestasi, dan risiko pembubaran. Reksa Dana Saham Nusantara Sejahtera tidak dijamin oleh PT Astra Capital Management Indonesia, Bank Kustodian, atau pihak manapun. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) tidak memberikan pernyataan menyetujui atau tidak menyetujui efek ini, dan tidak menyatakan kebenaran atau kecukupan isi prospektus.

# Laporan Keuangan Kuartal III 2023
## PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia

**Jakarta, 15 Oktober 2023** - PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia (MSTI) mengumumkan hasil kinerja keuangan untuk kuartal ketiga tahun 2023 yang menunjukkan pertumbuhan signifikan di semua lini bisnis.

### Ringkasan Kinerja Keuangan

Perusahaan mencatat pendapatan konsolidasi sebesar Rp 2,45 triliun pada Q3 2023, meningkat 18,5% dibandingkan kuartal sebelumnya. Pertumbuhan ini didorong oleh ekspansi layanan cloud computing dan solusi digital transformation yang semakin diminati oleh klien korporat.

Laba operasional mencapai Rp 687 miliar, naik 22,3% quarter-over-quarter (QoQ), mencerminkan efisiensi operasional yang lebih baik dan margin yang meningkat. Sementara itu, laba bersih tercatat Rp 512 miliar, tumbuh 15,8% dari kuartal sebelumnya.

### Tabel Perbandingan Kinerja Tiga Kuartal Terakhir

| Indikator | Q1 2023 | Q2 2023 | Q3 2023 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|

# Relazione Trimestrale sui Risultati Finanziari - Q3 2024

**Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A.**

Milano, 15 ottobre 2024

## Sintesi dei Risultati del Terzo Trimestre

Il Consiglio di Amministrazione di Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A. (GIM) ha approvato oggi i risultati consolidati per il terzo trimestre dell'esercizio fiscale 2024, chiuso al 30 settembre 2024.

### Andamento Economico-Finanziario

Il Gruppo ha registrato una performance solida nel terzo trimestre, con ricavi totali pari a €487,3 milioni, in crescita del 12,4% rispetto allo stesso periodo dell'anno precedente. L'EBITDA adjusted si è attestato a €94,6 milioni, con un margine del 19,4%.

La divisione Automotive ha contribuito significativamente ai risultati, generando €312,8 milioni di fatturato, mentre il settore Componenti Industriali ha raggiunto €174,5 milioni. L'utile operativo (EBIT) del trimestre è stato di €68,2 milioni, rappresentando un incremento del 15,7% su base annua.

## Dati Finanziari Consolidati

| Periodo | Ricavi (€ mln) | Utile Operativo (€ mln) | Utile Netto (€ mln) |
|---------|----------------|-------------------------|---------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 445,7 | 61,3 | 42,8 |
| Q2 2024 | 468,2 | 64,9 | 45,1 |
| Q3 2024 | 487,3 | 68,2 | 48,6 |

### Posizione Finanziaria Netta

Al 30 settembre 2024, la posizione finanziaria netta del Gruppo risulta positiva per €156,4 milioni, migliorata rispetto ai €142,7 milioni del trimestre precedente. Il flusso di cassa operativo ha raggiunto €73,5 milioni nel Q3.

### Prospettive

L'Amministratore Delegato, Dott. Marco Santini, ha dichiarato: "I risultati del terzo trimestre confermano la solidità del nostro modello di business. Prevediamo di chiudere l'anno fiscale 2024 con ricavi consolidati superiori a €1,9 miliardi e un utile netto nell'ordine di €185 milioni."

Il Gruppo conferma gli investimenti pianificati per €95 milioni nel 2024, focalizzati su innovazione tecnologica e sostenibilità ambientale.

**Codice Fiscale:** 00714930153  
**Data di Comunicazione:** 15 marzo 2024

## OGGETTO: Comunicazione ai sensi dell'art. 120 del D.Lgs. 58/1998

La presente comunicazione viene effettuata per informare il mercato della variazione significativa nella partecipazione azionaria della Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A.

### SOGGETTO DICHIARANTE

**Denominazione:** Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A.  
**Sede:** Avenue de la Liberté 45, 1002 Lussemburgo  
**Codice LEI:** 549300XQFX38T2V8K847

### DETTAGLI DELLA VARIAZIONE

In data 12 marzo 2024, Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. ha acquisito n. 8.750.000 azioni ordinarie di Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A. attraverso operazioni di mercato regolamentato (Borsa Italiana), per un controvalore complessivo di **€ 87.500.000,00** (ottantasette milioni cinquecentomila euro).

Il prezzo medio ponderato di acquisto è stato pari a **€ 10,00** per azione.

| **Partecipazione attuale** | **51.250.000** | **10,25%** | **10,25%** |

Il capitale sociale di Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A. è attualmente composto da n. 500.000.000 azioni ordinarie, ciascuna del valore nominale di € 0,50.

### FINALITÀ DELL'OPERAZIONE

L'acquisizione è stata effettuata con finalità di investimento strategico di medio-lungo termine. Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. intende supportare lo sviluppo delle attività della Banca nei mercati dell'Europa meridionale.

### CATENA PARTECIPATIVA

Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. è controllata al 75% da Holding Europa Investimenti S.p.A. (Milano) e al 25% da Fonds d'Investissement Stratégique (Parigi).

**Data:** 15 marzo 2024  
**Firma:** Dott. Alessandro Martinelli, Amministratore Delegato

The acquisition was made for the purpose of strategic medium to long-term investment. Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. intends to support the development of the Bank's activities in Southern European markets.

**Issuer:** Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A.  
**Registered Office:** Via Monte di Pietà 8, 20121 Milan (MI)  
**Tax Code:** 00714930153  
**Date of Notification:** 15 March 2024

## SUBJECT: Notification pursuant to Art. 120 of Legislative Decree 58/1998

This notification is made to inform the market of the material change in the shareholding in Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A.

### DECLARING PARTY

**Name:** Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A.  
**Registered Office:** Avenue de la Liberté 45, 1002 Luxembourg  
**LEI Code:** 549300XQFX38T2V8K847

### DETAILS OF THE CHANGE

On 12 March 2024, Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. acquired 8,750,000 ordinary shares of Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A. through transactions on the regulated market (Borsa Italiana), for a total consideration of **€87,500,000.00** (eighty-seven million five hundred thousand euros).

The weighted average purchase price was **€10.00** per share.

### SHAREHOLDING POSITION

| Description | Number of Shares | % of Share Capital | % of Voting Rights |
|-------------|------------------|--------------------|--------------------|
| Previous shareholding | 42,500,000 | 8.50% | 8.50% |
| Shares acquired | 8,750,000 | 1.75% | 1.75% |
| **Current shareholding** | **51,250,000** | **10.25%** | **10.25%** |

The share capital of Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A. currently consists of 500,000,000 ordinary shares, each with a nominal value of €0.50.

### PURPOSE OF THE TRANSACTION

The acquisition was made for strategic medium- to long-term investment purposes. Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. intends to support the development of the Bank’s activities in the Southern European markets.

### PARTICIPATION CHAIN

Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. is 75% controlled by Holding Europa Investimenti S.p.A. (Milan) and 25% controlled by Fonds d'Investissement Stratégique (Paris).

**Date:** 15 March 2024  
**Signature:** Dott. Alessandro Martinelli, Chief Executive Officer

**Issuer:** Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A.  
**Registered Office:** Via Monte di Pietà 8, 20121 Milan (MI)  
**Tax Code:** 00714930153  
**Date of Communication:** March 15, 2024

## SUBJECT: Notification pursuant to Article 120 of Legislative Decree No. 58/1998

This communication is issued to inform the market of a significant change in the shareholding of Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A.

### DECLARING PARTY

**Name:** Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A.  
**Address:** Avenue de la Liberté 45, 1002 Luxembourg  
**LEI Code:** 549300XQFX38T2V8K847

### DETAILS OF THE CHANGE

On March 12, 2024, Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. acquired 8,750,000 ordinary shares of Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A. through transactions on a regulated market (Borsa Italiana), for a total consideration of **€87,500,000.00** (eighty-seven million five hundred thousand euros).

The weighted average purchase price was **€10.00** per share.

### HOLDING POSITION

| Description | Number of Shares | % of Share Capital | % of Voting Rights |
|-------------|------------------|--------------------|--------------------|
| Previous holding | 42,500,000 | 8.50% | 8.50% |
| Shares acquired | 8,750,000 | 1.75% | 1.75% |
| **Current holding** | **51,250,000** | **10.25%** | **10.25%** |

The share capital of Banca Commerciale Italiana S.p.A. currently consists of 500,000,000 ordinary shares, each with a nominal value of €0.50.

### PURPOSE OF THE TRANSACTION

The acquisition was made for strategic medium- to long-term investment purposes. Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. intends to support the development of the Bank's activities in Southern European markets.

### HOLDING CHAIN

Gruppo Finanziario Mediterraneo S.A. is 75% owned by Holding Europa Investimenti S.p.A. (Milan) and 25% by Fonds d'Investissement Stratégique (Paris).

**Date:** March 15, 2024  
**Signature:** Alessandro Martinelli, Managing Director, Ph.D.

# Condizioni Generali del Conto Corrente Premium - Banca Nazionale Italiana S.p.A.

**Documento valido dal 1° marzo 2024**

## Art. 1 - Canone e Spese di Gestione

1.1 Il canone mensile per il mantenimento del Conto Corrente Premium è pari a €12,50, addebitato trimestralmente in via posticipata per un totale di €37,50.

1.2 Per i clienti con giacenza media trimestrale superiore a €50.000, il canone è ridotto del 40% a €7,50 mensili.

## Art. 2 - Commissioni Operative

2.1 Le operazioni di prelievo presso sportelli ATM Banca Nazionale Italiana sono gratuite senza limiti.

2.2 I prelievi presso ATM di altre banche comportano una commissione di €2,50 per operazione.

2.3 I bonifici SEPA online sono gratuiti fino a 20 operazioni mensili; oltre tale soglia si applica una commissione di €0,80 per bonifico.

## Art. 3 - Tassi di Interesse

| Tipo di Operazione | Tasso Applicato | Note |
|-------------------|-----------------|------|
| Interessi creditori | 0,15% annuo | Calcolati su giacenza media |
| Scoperto autorizzato | 9,75% annuo | Fino a €5.000 |
| Scoperto non autorizzato | 14,50% annuo | Commissione aggiuntiva €25 |

## Art. 4 - Carta di Debito

4.1 La carta di debito Mastercard è inclusa gratuitamente nel canone del conto.

4.2 Il plafond mensile è fissato a €3.000, modificabile su richiesta del cliente.

4.3 In caso di smarrimento o furto, la commissione per emissione duplicato è di €15,00.

## Art. 5 - Imposta di Bollo

5.1 L'imposta di bollo, pari a €34,20 annui per giacenze medie superiori a €5.000, viene addebitata il 31 dicembre di ogni anno.

## Art. 6 - Chiusura del Conto

6.1 La chiusura del conto è gratuita se richiesta dopo 12 mesi dall'apertura.

6.2 Per chiusure anticipate entro i primi 12 mesi si applica una penale di €50,00.

---

*Banca Nazionale Italiana S.p.A. - Sede Legale: Via Roma 145, 20121 Milano - P.IVA 01234567890*
samples.ref_text:
# General Terms and Conditions of the Premium Current Account - Banca Nazionale Italiana S.p.A.

**Document valid from 1 March 2024**

## Art. 1 - Account Fee and Management Charges

1.1 The monthly fee for maintaining the Premium Current Account is €12.50, debited quarterly in arrears for a total of €37.50.

1.2 For customers with an average quarterly balance exceeding €50,000, the fee is reduced by 40% to €7.50 per month.

## Art. 2 - Transaction Fees

2.1 Withdrawal transactions at Banca Nazionale Italiana ATMs are free of charge with no limits.

2.2 Withdrawals at other banks' ATMs incur a fee of €2.50 per transaction.

2.3 Online SEPA transfers are free of charge up to 20 transactions per month; beyond this threshold a fee of €0.80 per transfer applies.

## Art. 3 - Interest Rates

| Type of Transaction | Rate Applied | Notes |
|-------------------|-----------------|------|
| Credit interest | 0.15% per annum | Calculated on average balance |
| Authorised overdraft | 9.75% per annum | Up to €5,000 |
| Unauthorised overdraft | 14.50% per annum | Additional fee €25 |

## Art. 4 - Debit Card

4.1 The Mastercard debit card is included free of charge in the account fee.

4.2 The monthly spending limit is set at €3,000, adjustable upon customer request.

4.3 In the event of loss or theft, the fee for issuing a duplicate is €15.00.

## Art. 5 - Stamp Duty

5.1 Stamp duty, amounting to €34.20 per annum for average balances exceeding €5,000, is debited on 31 December of each year.

## Art. 6 - Account Closure

6.1 Account closure is free of charge if requested after 12 months from opening.

6.2 For early closures within the first 12 months a penalty of €50.00 applies.

---

*Banca Nazionale Italiana S.p.A. - Registered Office: Via Roma 145, 20121 Milan - VAT No. 01234567890*

# Scheda Prodotto - Fondo Comune di Investimento

## Eurogrowth Azionario Italia Plus

**Codice ISIN:** IT0005478962  
**Data di lancio:** 15 marzo 2018  
**Società di gestione:** Investimenti Bancari SGR S.p.A.  
**Depositario:** Banca Nazionale del Lavoro S.p.A.  
**Valuta di denominazione:** EUR  
**Patrimonio netto:** €247.350.000 (al 31 dicembre 2024)

### Obiettivo di Investimento

Il fondo Eurogrowth Azionario Italia Plus mira a conseguire una crescita del capitale nel medio-lungo termine attraverso investimenti prevalentemente in azioni di società italiane quotate sul mercato MTA di Borsa Italiana. Il fondo investe almeno il 70% del patrimonio in titoli azionari di emittenti con sede legale in Italia o che svolgono la parte predominante della loro attività economica nel territorio italiano. La restante quota può essere investita in strumenti del mercato monetario, obbligazioni governative e corporate investment grade.

### Struttura delle Commissioni

| Tipo di Commissione | Percentuale/Importo |
|---------------------|---------------------|
| Commissione di sottoscrizione | 2,50% |
| Commissione di gestione annua | 1,85% |
| Commissione di performance | 15% sulla sovraperformance vs FTSE MIB |
| Commissione di rimborso | 0,00% |
| Spese correnti (TER) | 2,12% |

### Rendimenti Storici Annuali

| Anno | Rendimento Netto | Benchmark (FTSE MIB) |
|------|------------------|----------------------|
| 2024 | +12,4% | +11,8% |
| 2023 | +18,7% | +16,2% |
| 2022 | -8,3% | -9,1% |
| 2021 | +22,5% | +21,3% |
| 2020 | -5,6% | -6,4% |

**Investimento minimo iniziale:** €5.000  
**Versamenti successivi minimi:** €500  
**Profilo di rischio SRRI:** 6 su 7

### Avvertenze sui Rischi

Il presente fondo è soggetto a rischio di mercato azionario elevato. Il valore delle quote può subire oscillazioni significative anche nel breve periodo. Non vi è garanzia di restituzione del capitale investito. I rendimenti passati non sono indicativi di quelli futuri. L'investimento in azioni comporta il rischio di perdita parziale o totale del capitale. Il fondo è esposto al rischio di concentrazione geografica sul mercato italiano e al rischio di cambio per eventuali investimenti in valute diverse dall'euro. Si raccomanda un orizzonte temporale di investimento minimo di 5 anni.

**ISIN Code:** IT0005478962

**Custodian:** Banca Nazionale del Lavoro S.p.A.  
**Denomination currency:** EUR  
**Net assets:** €247,350,000 (as at 31 December 2024)

### Investment Objective

The Eurogrowth Azionario Italia Plus fund aims to achieve capital growth over the medium to long term through investments primarily in shares of Italian companies listed on the MTA market of Borsa Italiana. The fund invests at least 70% of assets in equity securities of issuers with registered office in Italy or that conduct the predominant part of their business activity in Italian territory. The remaining portion may be invested in money market instruments, government bonds and investment grade corporate bonds.

### Fee Structure

| Fee Type | Percentage/Amount |
|----------|-------------------|
| Subscription fee | 2.50% |
| Annual management fee | 1.85% |
| Performance fee | 15% on outperformance vs FTSE MIB |
| Redemption fee | 0.00% |
| Ongoing charges (TER) | 2.12% |

### Annual Historical Returns

| Year | Net Return | Benchmark (FTSE MIB) |
|------|------------|----------------------|
| 2024 | +12.4% | +11.8% |
| 2023 | +18.7% | +16.2% |
| 2022 | -8.3% | -9.1% |
| 2021 | +22.5% | +21.3% |
| 2020 | -5.6% | -6.4% |

**Minimum initial investment:** €5,000  
**Minimum subsequent contributions:** €500  
**SRRI risk profile:** 6 out of 7

### Risk Warnings

This fund is subject to high equity market risk. The value of units may experience significant fluctuations even in the short term. There is no guarantee of return of invested capital. Past returns are not indicative of future returns. Investment in equities involves the risk of partial or total loss of capital. The fund is exposed to geographical concentration risk on the Italian market and to currency risk for any investments in currencies other than the euro. A minimum investment time horizon of 5 years is recommended.

# Relazione Trimestrale sui Risultati Finanziari - Q3 2024

**Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A.**

Milano, 15 ottobre 2024

## Sintesi dei Risultati del Terzo Trimestre

Il Consiglio di Amministrazione di Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A. (GIM) ha approvato oggi i risultati consolidati per il terzo trimestre dell'esercizio fiscale 2024, chiuso al 30 settembre 2024.

### Andamento Economico-Finanziario

Il Gruppo ha registrato una performance solida nel terzo trimestre, con ricavi totali pari a €487,3 milioni, in crescita del 12,4% rispetto allo stesso periodo dell'anno precedente. L'EBITDA adjusted si è attestato a €94,6 milioni, con un margine del 19,4%.

La divisione Automotive ha contribuito significativamente ai risultati, generando €312,8 milioni di fatturato, mentre il settore Componenti Industriali ha raggiunto €174,5 milioni. L'utile operativo (EBIT) del trimestre è stato di €68,2 milioni, rappresentando un incremento del 15,7% su base annua.

## Dati Finanziari Consolidati

| Periodo | Ricavi (€ mln) | Utile Operativo (€ mln) | Utile Netto (€ mln) |
|---------|----------------|-------------------------|---------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 445,7 | 61,3 | 42,8 |
| Q2 2024 | 468,9 | 65,7 | 46,2 |
| Q3 2024 | 487,3 | 68,2 | 48,9 |

### Posizione Finanziaria Netta

Al 30 settembre 2024, la posizione finanziaria netta del Gruppo risulta positiva per €156,4 milioni, migliorata rispetto ai €142,7 milioni del trimestre precedente. Il flusso di cassa operativo ha raggiunto €73,5 milioni nel Q3.

### Prospettive

L'Amministratore Delegato, Dott. Marco Bellini, ha dichiarato: "I risultati del terzo trimestre confermano la solidità del nostro modello di business. Prevediamo di chiudere l'anno fiscale 2024 con ricavi superiori a €1,9 miliardi e un margine EBITDA intorno al 19%."

Il Gruppo conferma gli investimenti pianificati di €85 milioni per l'innovazione tecnologica e la sostenibilità ambientale nei prossimi dodici mesi.

# Quarterly Financial Results Report - Q3 2024

**Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A.**

Milan, 15 October 2024

## Third Quarter Results Summary

The Board of Directors of Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A. (GIM) today approved the consolidated results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, ended 30 September 2024.

### Economic and Financial Performance

The Group recorded solid performance in the third quarter, with total revenues of €487.3 million, up 12.4% compared to the same period in the previous year. Adjusted EBITDA stood at €94.6 million, with a margin of 19.4%.

The Automotive division contributed significantly to the results, generating €312.8 million in revenue, while the Industrial Components sector reached €174.5 million. Operating profit (EBIT) for the quarter was €68.2 million, representing an increase of 15.7% year-on-year.

## Consolidated Financial Data

| Period  | Revenues (€ mln) | Operating Profit (€ mln) | Net Profit (€ mln) |
|---------|------------------|--------------------------|---------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 445.7 | 61.3 | 42.8 |
| Q2 2024 | 468.9 | 65.7 | 46.2 |
| Q3 2024 | 487.3 | 68.2 | 48.9 |

### Net Financial Position

At 30 September 2024, the Group's net financial position is positive at €156.4 million, improved compared to €142.7 million in the previous quarter. Operating cash flow reached €73.5 million in Q3.

### Outlook

The Chief Executive Officer, Dr. Marco Bellini, stated: "The third quarter results confirm the strength of our business model. We expect to close fiscal year 2024 with revenues exceeding €1.9 billion and an EBITDA margin of around 19%."

The Group confirms planned investments of €85 million for technological innovation and environmental sustainability over the next twelve months.

報告日：2024年11月15日

当社は2024年第3四半期（7月～9月）において、前年同期比で堅調な成長を達成いたしました。クラウドサービス事業の拡大とAIソリューション部門の好調により、売上高は前年同期比18.5%増の42,800百万円となりました。

営業利益は8,560百万円（前年同期比22.3%増）、純利益は5,940百万円（前年同期比19.8%増）を記録し、過去最高の四半期業績となりました。

| 項目 | 2024年Q1 | 2024年Q2 | 2024年Q3 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|

| 営業利益（百万円） | 7,200 | 7,850 | 8,560 |
| 純利益（百万円） | 4,980 | 5,420 | 5,940 |

**クラウドサービス事業：** 売上高25,680百万円（前年同期比24.5%増）  
企業のデジタルトランスフォーメーション需要の高まりにより、大型案件の受注が相次ぎました。特に金融機関向けのセキュリティソリューションが好調でした。

生成AI関連サービスの需要が急増し、製造業および小売業向けの導入案件が増加しました。

**システムインテグレーション事業：** 売上高4,780百万円（前年同期比3.8%増）  
既存顧客からの継続案件が安定的に推移しました。

# Third Quarter Financial Report for Fiscal Year 2024

**Technology Solutions Corporation**  
Report Date: November 15, 2024

## Business Performance Overview

In the third quarter of 2024 (July–September), the Company achieved solid growth compared to the same period of the previous year. Due to the expansion of our cloud services business and strong performance in our AI solutions division, net sales increased 18.5% year-on-year to ¥42,800 million.

Operating income was ¥8,560 million (up 22.3% year-on-year), and net income was ¥5,940 million (up 19.8% year-on-year), representing our highest quarterly performance to date.

## Quarterly Performance Trends

| Item | 2024 Q1 | 2024 Q2 | 2024 Q3 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|
| Net Sales (millions of yen) | 38,500 | 40,200 | 42,800 |
| Operating Income (millions of yen) | 7,200 | 7,850 | 8,560 |
| Net Income (millions of yen) | 4,980 | 5,420 | 5,940 |
| Operating Margin (%) | 18.7 | 19.5 | 20.0 |

## Performance by Segment

**Cloud Services Business:** Net sales of ¥25,680 million (up 24.5% year-on-year)  
Due to growing demand for corporate digital transformation, we secured a succession of large-scale projects. Security solutions for financial institutions performed particularly well.

**AI Solutions Business:** Net sales of ¥12,340 million (up 15.2% year-on-year)  
Demand for generative AI-related services surged, with an increase in implementation projects for the manufacturing and retail industries.

**Systems Integration Business:** Net sales of ¥4,780 million (up 3.8% year-on-year)  
Ongoing projects from existing customers progressed steadily.

## Full-Year Performance Forecast

For the full fiscal year 2024, we forecast net sales of ¥165,000 million (up 16.2% from the previous fiscal year), operating income of ¥31,500 million (up 18.5% from the previous fiscal year), and net income of ¥21,800 million (up 17.3% from the previous fiscal year).

We anticipate that growth in our cloud and AI businesses will continue in the fourth quarter, and we aim to achieve performance that exceeds our initial forecasts.

本ファンドの運用は、東京アセットマネジメント株式会社（金融商品取引業者 関東財務局長（金商）第1234号）が行います。

## 第3条（手数料体系）

本ファンドに係る手数料は以下の通りとします：

| 手数料種別 | 料率・金額 | 徴収時期 |
|---------|----------|---------|
| 購入時手数料 | 購入金額の3.30%（税込） | 購入時 |
| 信託報酬 | 純資産総額に対して年率1.65%（税込） | 日々計上 |
| 信託財産留保額 | 解約時の基準価額の0.30% | 解約時 |
| 監査報酬 | 年間1,200,000円（税込） | 年次 |

## 第4条（最低投資金額）

1. 初回購入時の最低投資金額は100,000円とします。
2. 追加購入時の最低投資金額は10,000円とします。
3. 積立投資プランの場合、月額5,000円から設定可能とします。

## 第5条（基準価額の計算）

1. 基準価額は、信託財産の純資産総額を受益権総口数で除した金額とし、1万口当たりの価額で表示します。
2. 基準価額の計算は、原則として毎営業日の午後3時における信託財産の資産評価額に基づき行います。

## 第6条（収益分配）

1. 収益分配は年2回、毎年5月15日および11月15日（休業日の場合は翌営業日）に決算を行い、分配金を支払います。
2. 分配金は1万口当たり50円を下限とし、運用状況により変動します。
3. 分配金の再投資を選択した場合、購入時手数料は無料とします。

## 第7条（解約）

1. 受益者は、販売会社の営業日において解約請求が可能です。
2. 解約代金は、解約請求受付日から起算して5営業日目からお支払いします。
3. 大量解約により信託財産の換金が困難な場合、解約請求の受付を中止することがあります。

## 第8条（課税関係）

普通分配金および解約時・償還時の譲渡益は、20.315%（所得税15.315%、住民税5%）の税率が適用されます。

## 第9条（約款の変更）

2024年4月1日より本約款を施行します。

# Investment Trust Agreement

## Article 1 (Name of Product)

This investment trust shall be called "Global Growth Equity Fund 2024" (hereinafter referred to as "the Fund").

## Article 2 (Management Company)

The Fund shall be managed by Tokyo Asset Management Co., Ltd. (Financial Instruments Business Operator, Kanto Local Finance Bureau Director (Kinsho) No. 1234).

## Article 3 (Fee Structure)

Fees related to the Fund shall be as follows:

| Fee Type | Rate/Amount | Collection Timing |
|---------|----------|---------|
| Purchase Fee | 3.30% of purchase amount (tax included) | At time of purchase |
| Trust Fee | Annual rate of 1.65% of total net assets (tax included) | Accrued daily |
| Trust Property Retention Amount | 0.30% of base price at time of redemption | At time of redemption |
| Audit Fee | 1,200,000 yen per annum (tax included) | Annual |

## Article 4 (Minimum Investment Amount)

1. The minimum investment amount for initial purchase shall be 100,000 yen.
2. The minimum investment amount for additional purchases shall be 10,000 yen.
3. In the case of an installment investment plan, it may be set from 5,000 yen per month.

## Article 5 (Calculation of Base Price)

1. The base price shall be the amount obtained by dividing the total net assets of the trust property by the total number of beneficial interest units, and shall be expressed as the price per 10,000 units.
2. The calculation of the base price shall, in principle, be conducted based on the asset valuation of the trust property at 3:00 p.m. on each business day.

## Article 6 (Income Distribution)

1. Income distribution shall be made twice a year, with settlements on May 15 and November 15 of each year (or the following business day if a holiday), and dividends shall be paid.
2. Dividends shall have a lower limit of 50 yen per 10,000 units and shall vary depending on management performance.
3. If reinvestment of dividends is selected, the purchase fee shall be waived.

## Article 7 (Redemption)

1. Beneficiaries may request redemption on business days of the sales company.
2. Redemption proceeds shall be paid from the fifth business day counting from the redemption request acceptance date.
3. In the event that liquidation of trust property becomes difficult due to large-scale redemptions, acceptance of redemption requests may be suspended.

## Article 8 (Taxation)

Ordinary dividends and capital gains at the time of redemption/maturity shall be subject to a tax rate of 20.315% (income tax 15.315%, resident tax 5%).

## Article 9 (Amendment of Agreement)

This agreement shall come into effect from April 1, 2024.

**株式会社テクノロジーソリューションズ**  
報告日：2024年11月15日

## 業績概要

当社は2024年第3四半期（7月～9月）において、前年同期比で堅調な成長を達成いたしました。クラウドサービス事業の拡大とAIソリューション部門の好調により、売上高は前年同期比18.5%増の42,800百万円となりました。

営業利益は8,560百万円（前年同期比22.3%増）、純利益は5,940百万円（前年同期比19.8%増）を記録し、過去最高の四半期業績となりました。

| 項目 | 2024年Q1 | 2024年Q2 | 2024年Q3 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|

| 純利益（百万円） | 4,980 | 5,420 | 5,940 |
| 営業利益率（%） | 18.7 | 19.5 | 20.0 |

## 事業部門別実績

**クラウドサービス事業部：** 売上高25,680百万円（前年同期比24.5%増）  
企業向けクラウドインフラサービスの需要が引き続き拡大し、新規契約数は前四半期比15%増加しました。

**AIソリューション事業部：** 売上高12,340百万円（前年同期比28.7%増）  
生成AI関連プロダクトの販売が好調で、特に金融業界向けソリューションが大幅に伸長しました。

**システムインテグレーション事業部：** 売上高4,780百万円（前年同期比2.1%減）  
一部大型案件の完了時期が第4四半期にずれ込んだため、微減となりました。

## 通期業績予想

2024年度通期の業績予想を上方修正いたします。売上高は165,000百万円（従来予想160,000百万円）、営業利益は32,500百万円（従来予想30,000百万円）、純利益は22,500百万円（従来予想20,800百万円）を見込んでおります。

第4四半期においても、デジタルトランスフォーメーション需要の継続的な拡大により、堅調な成長を維持する見通しです。

# Third Quarter Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2024

**Technology Solutions Corporation**  
Report Date: November 15, 2024

## Business Performance Overview

In the third quarter of 2024 (July–September), the Company achieved solid growth compared to the same period of the previous year. Due to the expansion of our cloud services business and strong performance in our AI solutions division, net sales increased 18.5% year-on-year to ¥42,800 million.

Operating income was ¥8,560 million (up 22.3% year-on-year), and net income was ¥5,940 million (up 19.8% year-on-year), representing our highest quarterly results to date.

## Quarterly Performance Trends

| Item | 2024 Q1 | 2024 Q2 | 2024 Q3 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|
| Net Sales (millions of yen) | 38,500 | 40,200 | 42,800 |
| Operating Income (millions of yen) | 7,200 | 7,850 | 8,560 |
| Net Income (millions of yen) | 4,980 | 5,420 | 5,940 |
| Operating Margin (%) | 18.7 | 19.5 | 20.0 |

## Results by Business Segment

**Cloud Services Division:** Net sales of ¥25,680 million (up 24.5% year-on-year)  
Demand for enterprise cloud infrastructure services continued to expand, with new contracts increasing 15% compared to the previous quarter.

**AI Solutions Division:** Net sales of ¥12,340 million (up 28.7% year-on-year)  
Sales of generative AI-related products were strong, with solutions for the financial services industry showing particularly significant growth.

**Systems Integration Division:** Net sales of ¥4,780 million (down 2.1% year-on-year)  
Results declined slightly as the completion timing of certain large-scale projects was pushed back to the fourth quarter.

## Full-Year Performance Forecast

We are revising our full-year performance forecast for fiscal year 2024 upward. We expect net sales of ¥165,000 million (previous forecast: ¥160,000 million), operating income of ¥32,500 million (previous forecast: ¥30,000 million), and net income of ¥22,500 million (previous forecast: ¥20,800 million).

In the fourth quarter as well, we anticipate maintaining solid growth due to the continued expansion of digital transformation demand.

# COMUNICADO AO MERCADO
## Alteração de Participação Acionária Relevante

**Data de Divulgação:** 15 de março de 2024  
**Empresa Emissora:** Tecnologia Avançada Brasil S.A. (TAB)  
**CNPJ:** 12.345.678/0001-90  
**Código de Negociação:** TECB3

### FATO RELEVANTE

A Tecnologia Avançada Brasil S.A. ("Companhia" ou "TAB"), em cumprimento às disposições da Instrução CVM nº 358/02 e da Lei nº 6.404/76, comunica aos seus acionistas e ao mercado em geral que foi notificada em 14 de março de 2024 sobre alteração significativa na composição acionária da Companhia.

### DETALHES DA OPERAÇÃO

O fundo de investimento **Investimentos Globais Participações Ltda.**, CNPJ 98.765.432/0001-11, adquiriu em 13 de março de 2024, através de operações realizadas na B3 S.A. - Brasil, Bolsa, Balcão, um total de 8.750.000 (oito milhões, setecentas e cinquenta mil) ações ordinárias de emissão da Companhia, representando 12,5% do capital social total.

O valor total da transação foi de **R$ 262.500.000,00** (duzentos e sessenta e dois milhões e quinhentos mil reais), correspondendo a um preço médio de R$ 30,00 por ação.

### COMPOSIÇÃO ACIONÁRIA ATUALIZADA

| Acionista | Quantidade de Ações | Percentual (%) | Tipo |
|-----------|---------------------|----------------|------|
| Investimentos Globais Participações Ltda. | 8.750.000 | 12,5% | ON |
| Fundação Previdenciária Securitas | 7.000.000 | 10,0% | ON |
| Família Rodrigues Silva | 5.250.000 | 7,5% | ON |
| Ações em Tesouraria | 1.400.000 | 2,0% | ON |
| Ações em Circulação (Free Float) | 47.600.000 | 68,0% | ON |
| **Total** | **70.000.000** | **100,0%** | **ON** |

### INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

A Investimentos Globais Participações Ltda. declarou que a aquisição tem caráter estratégico de investimento de longo prazo e que não pretende, neste momento, alterar a composição da administração da Companhia. O prazo para liquidação financeira da operação foi estabelecido para 18 de março de 2024 (D+3).

A Companhia permanece à disposição dos acionistas e do mercado para quaisquer esclarecimentos adicionais.

**São Paulo, 15 de março de 2024**

**Ricardo Mendes Oliveira**  
Diretor de Relações com Investidores  
Tecnologia Avançada Brasil S.A.

### TRANSACTION DETAILS

The investment fund **Investimentos Globais Participações Ltda.**, CNPJ 98.765.432/0001-11, acquired on March 13, 2024, through transactions carried out on B3 S.A. - Brasil, Bolsa, Balcão, a total of 8,750,000 (eight million, seven hundred and fifty thousand) common shares issued by the Company, representing 12.5% of the total share capital.

The total transaction value was **R$ 262,500,000.00** (two hundred and sixty-two million and five hundred thousand reais), corresponding to an average price of R$ 30.00 per share.

| **Total** | **70,000,000** | **100.0%** | **ON** |

# Descrição do Fundo de Investimento Multimercado Atlas Estratégia Global

**CNPJ:** 42.156.789/0001-23  
**Data de Constituição:** 15 de março de 2018  
**Administrador:** Banco Safira S.A.  
**Gestor:** Atlas Capital Gestão de Recursos Ltda.

## Objetivo do Fundo

O Fundo de Investimento Multimercado Atlas Estratégia Global tem como objetivo proporcionar aos seus cotistas valorização de capital no longo prazo através de investimentos diversificados em ativos financeiros de renda fixa e renda variável, tanto no mercado doméstico quanto internacional. O fundo pode aplicar até 67% de seu patrimônio líquido em ativos de renda variável e utilizar derivativos para alavancagem.

## Público-Alvo

Investidores em geral que buscam diversificação internacional e aceitam os riscos inerentes aos mercados de capitais, incluindo variação cambial e volatilidade de preços.

**Aplicação Inicial Mínima:** R$ 5.000,00  
**Movimentação Mínima:** R$ 1.000,00  
**Saldo Mínimo de Permanência:** R$ 2.500,00

## Estrutura de Taxas e Custos

| Tipo de Taxa | Percentual | Base de Cálculo |
|--------------|-----------|-----------------|
| Taxa de Administração | 2,00% a.a. | Patrimônio Líquido |
| Taxa de Performance | 20% | Sobre o que exceder 100% do CDI |
| Taxa de Entrada | 0% | Não aplicável |
| Taxa de Saída | 0% | Não aplicável |

## Rentabilidade Histórica

| Ano | Rentabilidade do Fundo | CDI | Diferença |
|-----|----------------------|-----|-----------|
| 2023 | 18,45% | 13,15% | +5,30% |
| 2022 | 15,87% | 13,65% | +2,22% |
| 2021 | 8,92% | 4,40% | +4,52% |
| 2020 | 12,34% | 2,75% | +9,59% |
| 2019 | 22,18% | 5,96% | +16,22% |

**Patrimônio Líquido Atual:** R$ 487.350.000,00 (posição em 31/01/2024)

## Aviso de Risco

**ATENÇÃO:** Este fundo utiliza estratégias com derivativos como parte integrante de sua política de investimento. # Relatório de Resultados Trimestrais - Q3 2024
## Banco Atlântico S.A.

**Data de Divulgação:** 15 de novembro de 2024

### Resumo Executivo

O Banco Atlântico S.A. apresenta seus resultados consolidados referentes ao terceiro trimestre de 2024, demonstrando crescimento consistente em suas principais linhas de negócio. A instituição registrou receita líquida de R$ 2,8 bilhões no período, representando um aumento de 12,3% em relação ao trimestre anterior.

### Desempenho Financeiro Consolidado

| Período | Receita Total (R$ milhões) | Lucro Operacional (R$ milhões) | Lucro Líquido (R$ milhões) |
|---------|----------------------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 2.345,7 | 876,2 | 654,8 |
| Q2 2024 | 2.492,3 | 923,5 | 701,2 |
| Q3 2024 | 2.799,1 | 1.047,8 | 789,6 |

### Análise dos Resultados

Durante o terceiro trimestre de 2024, o Banco Atlântico expandiu significativamente sua carteira de crédito corporativo, alcançando R$ 45,6 bilhões em ativos sob gestão. A margem financeira bruta atingiu R$ 1,9 bilhão, com crescimento de 15,7% comparado ao Q2 2024.

As despesas operacionais totalizaram R$ 1,2 bilhão, mantendo o índice de eficiência em 42,8%, demonstrando disciplina na gestão de custos. A provisão para devedores duvidosos foi de R$ 287,4 milhões, refletindo uma taxa de inadimplência controlada de 2,1%.

### Destaques Operacionais

- **Carteira de Crédito:** Crescimento de 8,9% no trimestre, totalizando R$ 78,3 bilhões
- **Base de Clientes:** Adição de 245.000 novos correntistas, alcançando 8,7 milhões de clientes ativos
- **ROE (Return on Equity):** 18,4% no acumulado de 12 meses
- **Índice de Basileia:** 16,2%, significativamente acima do mínimo regulatório

### Perspectivas

A administração mantém perspectiva positiva para o Q4 2024, projetando crescimento sustentável da receita entre 9% e 11%, impulsionado pela expansão digital e produtos de investimento.

**Contato para Investidores:** ri@bancoatlantico.com.br

# Quarterly Results Report - Q3 2024
## Banco Atlântico S.A.

**Release Date:** November 15, 2024

### Executive Summary

Banco Atlântico S.A. presents its consolidated results for the third quarter of 2024, demonstrating consistent growth across its main business lines. The institution recorded net revenue of R$ 2.8 billion in the period, representing an increase of 12.3% compared to the previous quarter.

### Consolidated Financial Performance

| Period | Total Revenue (R$ millions) | Operating Income (R$ millions) | Net Income (R$ millions) |
|---------|----------------------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 2,345.7 | 876.2 | 654.8 |
| Q2 2024 | 2,492.3 | 923.5 | 701.2 |
| Q3 2024 | 2,799.1 | 1,047.8 | 789.6 |

### Results Analysis

During the third quarter of 2024, Banco Atlântico significantly expanded its corporate credit portfolio, reaching R$ 45.6 billion in assets under management. Gross financial margin reached R$ 1.9 billion, with growth of 15.7% compared to Q2 2024.

Operating expenses totaled R$ 1.2 billion, maintaining the efficiency ratio at 42.8%, demonstrating discipline in cost management. The allowance for doubtful accounts was R$ 287.4 million, reflecting a controlled delinquency rate of 2.1%.

### Operating Highlights

- **Credit Portfolio:** Growth of 8.9% in the quarter, totaling R$ 78.3 billion
- **Customer Base:** Addition of 245,000 new account holders, reaching 8.7 million active customers
- **ROE (Return on Equity):** 18.4% on a 12-month trailing basis
- **Basel Ratio:** 16.2%, significantly above the regulatory minimum

### Outlook

Management maintains a positive outlook for Q4 2024, projecting sustainable revenue growth between 9% and 11%, driven by digital expansion and investment products.

**Investor Contact:** ri@bancoatlantico.com.br

## Отчет о финансовых результатах за III квартал 2024 года

**Дата публикации:** 15 октября 2024 г.  
**Отчетный период:** июль - сентябрь 2024 г.

### Основные финансовые показатели

ООО "Северная Промышленная Группа" представляет консолидированные финансовые результаты за третий квартал 2024 года. Компания продолжает демонстрировать устойчивый рост основных финансовых показателей благодаря расширению производственных мощностей и оптимизации операционных процессов.

| Показатель | Q1 2024 | Q2 2024 | Q3 2024 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|
| Выручка (млн руб.) | 4 567,3 | 5 234,8 | 5 891,2 |
| Операционная прибыль (млн руб.) | 892,4 | 1 045,7 | 1 234,5 |
| Чистая прибыль (млн руб.) | 634,8 | 756,2 | 891,7 |

### Анализ результатов

Выручка компании в третьем квартале 2024 года составила 5 891,2 млн рублей, что на 12,5% превышает показатель предыдущего квартала и на 23,7% выше результата аналогичного периода прошлого года.
